        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Launch Mode Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Per specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Current Implementation",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### Platform Admin",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Merchant Member Management",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access**: Merchant admin only",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Feature Flags (To Implement)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "The specification requires:",

          },
          {
            "text": "- Feature flags per merchant",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kill switch per merchant",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Invite-only merchant signup",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Recommended Implementation",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "// Add to Merchant model",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "model Merchant {",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "  // ... existing fields",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "}",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",

          },

            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {

          },

          },

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works",

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2. **Connect repository**\n3. **Build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Start command**: &#96;npm start&#96;\n5. **Environment**: Add all environment variables\n6. **Database**: Create PostgreSQL service\n7. **Redis**: Create Redis service (optional)\n\n### Fly.io\n\n1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# Changelog\n\n## [1.0.0] - 2024-01-XX\n\n### Added\n- Multi-tenant voucher platform with merchant isolation\n- Voucher creation, publishing, and management\n- Referral system with shareable links\n- Credit system (locked/unlocked states)\n- Weekly drop functionality with stock management\n- PWA support with service worker and offline QR codes\n- RBAC (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- Fraud prevention (rate limiting, self-referral prevention)\n- Email magic link authentication\n- Google and Apple OAuth support\n- Merchant dashboard\n- User wallet and credit management\n- Checkout demo for credit application\n- API documentation\n- Unit tests for credit system\n- Seed data script\n- Docker compose setup for local development\n\n### Technical\n- Next.js 14 with App Router\n- TypeScript strict mode\n- Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL\n- TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui components\n- NextAuth for authentication\n- Zod for validation\n- Vitest for testing\n- i18n structure (next-intl, ready for expansion)\n\n## [1.1.0] - 2024-01-XX (Planned)\n\n### Added\n- Voucher publish endpoint\n- Voucher update endpoint\n- Better error handling with custom error classes\n- Type definitions\n- Session provider for client components\n- Validation utilities\n\n### Fixed\n- Missing publish functionality\n- TypeScript type safety improvements",

        "contents": "// This is your Prisma schema file,\n// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema\n\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"postgresql\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\nmodel Account {\n  id                String  @id @default(cuid())\n  userId            String\n  type              String\n  provider          String\n  providerAccountId String\n  refresh_token     String? @db.Text\n  access_token      String? @db.Text\n  expires_at        Int?\n  token_type        String?\n  scope             String?\n  id_token          String? @db.Text\n  session_state     String?\n\n  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Session {\n  id           String   @id @default(cuid())\n  sessionToken String   @unique\n  userId       String\n  expires      DateTime\n  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel VerificationToken {\n  identifier String\n  token      String   @unique\n  expires    DateTime\n\n  @@unique([identifier, token])\n}\n\nmodel User {\n  id            String    @id @default(cuid())\n  email         String    @unique\n  emailVerified DateTime?\n  name          String?\n  image         String?\n  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  accounts         Account[]\n  sessions         Session[]\n  merchantMembers  MerchantMember[]\n  referrals        Referral[]         @relation(\"Referrer\")\n  redemptions      Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedBy\")\n  staffRedemptions Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedByStaff\")\n  creditLedgers    CreditLedger[]\n  creditUsages     CreditUsage[]\n  voucherPurchases VoucherPurchase[]\n  ticketPurchases  TicketPurchase[]\n  auditLogs        AuditLog[]\n}\n\nmodel Merchant {\n  ",

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "# Pilot Program: First 10 Merchants\n\n**Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit** — proof, learning, testimonials.  \nNot scale.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Merchant Selection Checklist\n\nUse this **before** outreach. A prospect must satisfy ALL in Section A and at least one in Section B.  \nIf any Section A item is NO → skip.\n\n### Section A — Must have (all YES)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Local or regional business (not national/global) | | |\n| 2 | High trust, repeat customers (regulars) | | |\n| 3 | Easy-to-understand service or product | | |\n| 4 | Owner involved in daily operations | | |\n| 5 | Comfortable with WhatsApp, phone, or email | | |\n\n### Section B — Best fit (at least one)\n\n| # | Category | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Café or coffee shop | |\n| 2 | Salon or barbershop | |\n| 3 | Gym or studio | |\n| 4 | Tool rental or service business | |\n| 5 | Small retail with regulars | |\n\n### Section C — Exclude (any YES → skip)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Big chain or franchise | |\n| 2 | Pure e‑commerce (no in‑person/regulars) | |\n| 3 | Discount‑driven / race‑to‑bottom positioning | |\n\n**Verdict:** _________________________________ (IN / OUT)  \n**Reason if OUT:** _________________________________\n\n---\n\n## 2. Outreach Script\n\n### 2a. Opening (DM / WhatsApp / SMS)\n\n&gt; I’m testing a new way to turn your regular customers into your best salespeople, without ads.  \n&gt; Can I show you in 10 minutes?\n\n*If they say yes:*  \n&gt; When’s a good 10‑minute slot this week? I can call or stop by.\n\n*If they ask “what is it?”:*  \n&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. You control the offer and the credit. I’ll set it up with you.\n\n---\n\n### 2b. Phone / in‑person (10‑minute show)\n\n**Minute 0–1 — Hook**  \n&gt; You know your best new customers usually come from people who already like you. We’re testing a simple system: your regulars share a voucher, their friend uses it, you decide how much credit the sharer gets. No ads, you stay in control.\n\n**Minute 2–4 — What they get**  \n&gt; You get one main voucher — e.g. “15% off first visit” — and one weekly drop: a limited batch, e.g. 30 vouchers for 48 hours. When a friend redeems, your staff confirms in one tap. The referrer gets credit you set — e.g. €5 — to spend with you.",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\n\nexport default async function AdminPage() {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  // Simple admin check - in production, use proper platform_admin flag\n  const isAdmin = process.env.PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS?.split(',').includes(session.user.email || '');\n\n  if (!isAdmin) {\n    redirect('/app');\n  }\n\n  const [merchantCount, userCount, voucherCount, redemptionCount] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.merchant.count(),\n    prisma.user.count(),\n    prisma.voucher.count(),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen p-4\"&gt;\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 199
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 267
          }
        },
        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt;         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { unlockCreditForRedemption } from '@/lib/credits';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!redemption) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (redemption.confirmedAt) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption already confirmed' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Require merchant staff or admin role\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, redemption.merchantId, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    // Confirm redemption\n    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      await tx.redemption.update({\n        where: { id: params.id },\n        data: { confirmedAt: new Date(), redeemedByStaffUserId: session.user.id },\n      });\n\n      // Unlock credit if referral exists\n      if (redemption.referralId) {\n        await unlockCreditForRedemption(params.id, redemption.merchantId);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error confirming redemption:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n    if (data.referralId &amp;&amp; session?.user?.id) {\n      const isSelf = await isSelfReferral(data.referralId, session.user.id);\n      if (isSelf) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cannot redeem your own referral' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        const rateLimit = await checkRedemptionRateLimit(referral.friendHash);\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n}",

        "contents": "export async function applyCredit(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string,\n  amount: number,\n  orderReference: string\n): Promise&lt;{ success: boolean; creditIds: string[] }&gt; {\n\n\n  // Use transaction to atomically update credits and create usage record\n  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n    // Mark credits as used (or partially used)\n    for (const { id, amount: useAmount } of creditsToUse) {\n      const credit = await tx.creditLedger.findUnique({\n        where: { id },\n      });\n\n      if (!credit) continue;\n\n      if (useAmount === credit.amount) {\n        // Fully used\n        await tx.creditLedger.update({\n          where: { id },\n          data: { status: 'used' },\n        });\n      } else {\n        // Partially used - create new ledger entry for remaining\n        await tx.creditLedger.update({\n          where: { id },\n          data: { status: 'used' },\n        });\n        await tx.creditLedger.create({\n          data: {\n            merchantId,\n            userId,\n            amount: credit.amount - useAmount,\n            currency: credit.currency,\n            status: 'available',\n            source: credit.source,\n            sourceId: credit.sourceId,\n            expiresAt: credit.expiresAt,\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create usage record\n    await tx.creditUsage.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId,\n        userId,\n        creditLedgerIds: creditIds,\n        amountUsed: amount,\n        orderReference,\n      },\n    });\n  });\n\n  return { success: true, creditIds };\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { ensureMerchantOwnership } from '@/lib/tenant';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, voucher.merchantId, 'merchant_admin');\n\n    // Validate voucher can be published\n    if (voucher.status === 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher already published' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    if (!voucher.designJson) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher design is required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Update status to published\n    const updated = await prisma.voucher.update({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      data: { status: 'published' },\n    });\n\n    // Log audit\n    await prisma.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        actorUserId: session.user.id,\n        action: 'voucher.published',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: params.id }),\n      },\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json(updated);\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error publishing voucher:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\n\n/**\n * Unlock credit after redemption confirmation\n */\nexport async function unlockCreditForRedemption(\n  redemptionId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n    where: { id: redemptionId },\n    include: {\n      referral: {\n        include: {\n          referrer: true,\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!redemption || !redemption.referral) {\n    throw new Error('Redemption not found or has no referral');\n  }\n\n  if (redemption.merchantId !== merchantId) {\n    throw new Error('Merchant mismatch');\n  }\n\n  // Find locked credit for this redemption\n  const lockedCredit = await prisma.creditLedger.findFirst({\n    where: {\n      merchantId,\n      source: 'referral_redemption',\n      sourceId: redemptionId,\n      status: 'locked',\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!lockedCredit) {\n    // Credit might already be unlocked or doesn't exist\n    return;\n  }\n\n  // Unlock the credit\n  await prisma.creditLedger.update({\n    where: { id: lockedCredit.id },\n    data: {\n      status: 'available',\n    },\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Get user's credit balance for a merchant\n */\nexport async function getCreditBalance(\n  userId: string,\n  merchantId: string\n): Promise&lt;{\n  available: number;\n  locked: number;\n  total: number;\n  currency: string;\n  credits: Array&lt;{\n    id: string;\n    amount: number;\n    status: string;\n    expiresAt: Date | null;\n    createdAt: Date;\n  }&gt;;\n}&gt; {\n  \n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {

          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 112,
            "column": 1
          }

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst claimSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = claimSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher with weekly drop info\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher || !voucher.weeklyDropEnabled) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found or weekly drop not enabled' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const weeklyDrop = voucher.weeklyDropJson\n      ? (JSON.parse(voucher.weeklyDropJson as string) as {\n          dayOfWeek: number;\n          startTime: string;\n          stock: number;\n          durationMinutes: number;\n        })\n      : null;\n\n    if (!weeklyDrop) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop configuration missing' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check if we're in the drop window\n    const now = new Date();\n    const dayOfWeek = now.getDay();\n    const [hours, minutes] = weeklyDrop.startTime.split(':').map(Number);\n    const startTime = new Date(now);\n    startTime.setHours(hours, minutes, 0, 0);\n    const endTime = new Date(startTime);\n    endTime.setMinutes(endTime.getMinutes() + weeklyDrop.durationMinutes);\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime)\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Weekly drop sold out') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error claiming weekly drop:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        },
        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

Referral\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPOST /api/referrals/create\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: Required\n\n**Body**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"voucherId\": \"clx...\",\n  \"friendHint\": tracking)\n\n**Body**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"voucherId\": \"clx...\",\n  \"referralId\": \"clx...\",  // optional\n  \"method\": \"online\" | \"in_store\",\n  \"orderReference\": \"ORD-001\",  // optional\n  \"amountBeforeDiscount\": 5000,  // minor units\n  \"discountApplied\": 750,  // minor units\n  \"currency\": \"USD\"\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"redemptionId\": \"clx...\",\n  \"requiresConfirmation\": false\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Confirm Redemption\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;http\nPOST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Auth**: optional\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Response**:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;json\n{\n  \"success\": true,\n  \"creditIds\": [\"clx...\"]\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n#### Claim Weekly         "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { applyCredit } from '@/lib/credits';\nimport { getMerchantBySlug } from '@/lib/tenant';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst applyCreditSchema = z.object({\n  merchantSlug: z.string(),\n  amount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { merchantSlug, amount, orderReference } = applyCreditSchema.parse(body);\n\n    const merchant = await getMerchantBySlug(merchantSlug);\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    const result = await applyCredit(session.user.id, merchant.id, amount, orderReference || '');\n\n    return NextResponse.json(result);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Insufficient credit balance') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error applying credit:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export async function PUT(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { slug: string; id: string } }\n) {\n\n    if (data.usageLimitTotal !== undefined) updateData.usageLimitTotal = data.usageLimitTotal;\n    if (data.usageLimitPerUser !== undefined) updateData.usageLimitPerUser = data.usageLimitPerUser;\n    if (data.weeklyDropEnabled !== undefined) updateData.weeklyDropEnabled = data.weeklyDropEnabled;\n    if (data.weeklyDropJson !== undefined) {\n      updateData.weeklyDropJson = data.weeklyDropJson ? Max 5 min | |\n| 10 | Give merchant link to their voucher / referral page | |\n| 11 | Confirm: how they’ll tell regulars (in‑store, WhatsApp, etc.) | |\n| 12 | Agree: feedback call in 7–10 days. Set date: __________ | |\n\n### After the session\n\n| # | Task | ✓ |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 13 | Log merchant in your tracker (name, category, go‑live date) | |\n| 14 | Send 1‑line recap (voucher, drop, credit) by WhatsApp/email | |\n\n**Merchant:** _________________  \n**Go‑live date:** _________________  \n**Setup done by:** _________________\n\n---\n\n## 4. Any confusion?*  \n   - Notes: _________________________________\n\n2. **Did staff find it easy?**  \n   - *Redemption, any frictions?*  \n   - Notes: _________________________________\n\n3. **Would you keep this if it cost money?**  \n   - *What would you be willing to pay? (Don’t propose numbers. Listen.)*  \n   - Notes: _________________________________\n\n4. **What felt confusing?**  \n   - *Setup, wording, credit, weekly drop?*  \n   - Notes: _________________________________\n\n### Optional (if time)\n\n1. **Anything that would make you recommend this to another merchant?**  \n   - Notes: _________________________________",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\n\nexport default function ConfirmRedemptionButton({\n  redemptionId,\n  merchantSlug,\n}: {\n  redemptionId: string;\n  merchantSlug: string;\n}) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleConfirm = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('Confirm this redemption? This will unlock credit for the referrer.')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;/api/redemptions/${redemptionId}/confirm&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to confirm redemption');\n      }\n\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (error) {\n      alert('Failed to confirm redemption');\n      console.error(error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={isLoading}&gt;\n      {isLoading ? 'Confirming...' : 'Confirm Redemption'}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "# Deployment Guide\n\n## Pre-Deployment Checklist\n\n- [ ] All environment variables configured\n- [ ] Database migrations run\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] SMTP configured for email magic links\n- [ ] OAuth providers configured (if using)\n- [ ] PWA icons generated (192x192 and 512x512 PNG)\n- [ ] Object storage configured (for brand assets)\n- [ ] Redis configured (for rate limiting in production)\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nRequired for production:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# App\nNODE_ENV=production\nNEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL=https://your-domain.com\n\n# Database\nDATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:password@host:5432/dbname\n\n# Redis (recommended for production)\nREDIS_URL=redis://host:6379\n\n# Auth\nAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\nNEXTAUTH_URL=https://your-domain.com\nNEXTAUTH_SECRET=&lt;generate-random-32-chars&gt;\n\n# OAuth (optional)\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_ID=\nGOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_ID=\nAPPLE_CLIENT_SECRET=\nAPPLE_TEAM_ID=\nAPPLE_KEY_ID=\n\n# Email\nSMTP_HOST=smtp.example.com\nSMTP_PORT=587\nSMTP_USER=noreply@your-domain.com\nSMTP_PASSWORD=\nSMTP_FROM=noreply@your-domain.com\n\n# Object Storage (S3 compatible)\nS3_ENDPOINT=\nS3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=\nS3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=\nS3_BUCKET=\nS3_REGION=\n\n# Platform Admin\nPLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS=admin@your-domain.com\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment Options\n\n### Vercel (Recommended)\n\n1. **Connect repository** to Vercel\n2. **Configure environment variables** in Vercel dashboard\n3. **Set build command**: &#96;npm run build&#96;\n4. **Set output directory**: &#96;.next&#96;\n5. **Database**: Use Vercel Postgres or external provider\n6. **Redis**: Use Upstash Redis or external provider\n\n### Render\n\n1. **Create new Web Service**\n2.         "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;         "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 75
          }
        },
        "contents": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte\n\n## ✅ Valmis täiustused\n\n### 1. Toast Notifications System\n- ✅ Radix UI toast komponendid\n- ✅ Success, error, info variandid\n- ✅ Auto-dismiss funktsioon\n- ✅ Helper funktsioonid (&#96;showSuccess&#96;, &#96;showError&#96;, &#96;showInfo&#96;)\n- ✅ Integreeritud root layout'is\n\n### 2. Loading States\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent spinner'iga\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; komponent loading state'ide jaoks\n- ✅ Näide kasutamisest &#96;publish-button.tsx&#96;'is\n\n### 3. Analytics Dashboard\n- ✅ Uus analytics leht (&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;)\n- ✅ Total redemptions, revenue, credits issued\n- ✅ Top vouchers statistika\n- ✅ Recent redemptions list\n- ✅ Link dashboard'ist\n\n### 4. UI Komponendid\n- ✅ &#96;Select&#96; komponent (Radix UI)\n- ✅ &#96;Skeleton&#96; loading komponent\n- ✅ &#96;LoadingButton&#96; komponent\n- ✅ &#96;Toast&#96; süsteem\n\n## 📋 Järgmised sammud (valikuline)\n\n### Prioriteet 1\n1. **Asendada kõik alert() kutsed toast'idega**\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/merchant/[slug]/redemptions/confirm-button.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/r/[id]/referral-client.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo/page.tsx&#96;\n   - &#96;app/v/[id]/voucher-client.tsx&#96;\n\n2. **Voucher otsing ja filtreerimine**\n   - Otsing välja\n   - Filtreerimine staatuse, tüübi, kuupäeva järgi\n   - Sortimine\n\n3. **Parem error handling UI**\n   - Error boundaries\n   - Retry mechanisms\n\n### Prioriteet 2\n4. **Email notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n\n5. **Voucher mallid**\n   - Eeldefineeritud mallid\n   - Mallide salvestamine\n   - Kiire loomine\n\n6. **Export funktsioonid**\n   - CSV export redemptions\n   - Credits ledger export\n\n### Prioriteet 3\n7. **Graafikud ja visualisatsioonid**\n   - Chart.js või Recharts integratsioon\n   - Time-series graafikud\n   - Conversion funnels\n\n8. **Bulk operations**\n   - Mitme voucher'i korraga avaldamine\n   - CSV import\n\n## 🚀 Kuidas kasutada",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Täiustuste kokkuvõte",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { checkRedemptionRateLimit, isSelfReferral } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createRedemptionSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  referralId: z.string().optional(),\n  method: z.enum(['online', 'in_store']),\n  orderReference: z.string().optional(),\n  amountBeforeDiscount: z.number().int().positive(),\n  discountApplied: z.number().int().nonnegative(),\n  currency: z.string(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const data = createRedemptionSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: data.voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check validity dates\n    const now = new Date();\n    if (now &lt; voucher.validFrom || now &gt; voucher.validTo) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher expired or not yet valid' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { checkReferralRateLimit } from '@/lib/fraud';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst createReferralSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(), // optional identifier hint for friend\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = createReferralSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check rate limit\n    const rateLimit = await checkReferralRateLimit(session.user.id);\n    if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n      return NextResponse.json(\n        { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n        { status: 429 }\n      );\n    }\n\n    // Hash friend identifier if provided\n    const friendHash = friendHint\n      ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n      : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n    // Create referral\n    const referral = await prisma.referral.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n        friendHash,\n        status: 'created',\n      },\n    });\n\n    // Generate share URL\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json\n\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const merchantSlug = req.nextUrl.searchParams.get('merchantSlug');\n    if (!merchantSlug) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant slug required' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n      where: { slug: merchantSlug },\n    });\n\n    if (!merchant) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Merchant not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    const redemptions = await prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n        referral: {\n          include: {\n            referrer: {\n              select: { name: true, email: true },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },\n    });\n\n    // Generate CSV\n    const headers = [\n      'ID',\n      'Voucher ID',\n      'Voucher Type',\n      'Method',\n      'Order Reference',\n      'Amount Before Discount',\n      'Discount Applied',\n      'Currency',\n      'Referrer',\n      'Confirmed At',\n      'Created At',\n    ];\n\n    const rows = redemptions.map((r) =&gt; [\n      r.id,\n      r.voucher.id,\n      r.voucher.type,\n      r.method,\n      r.orderReference || '',\n      String(r.amountBeforeDiscount / 100),\n      String(r.discountApplied / 100),\n      r.currency,\n      r.referral?.referrer?.email || '',\n      r.confirmedAt ? new Date(r.confirmedAt).toISOString() : '',\n      new Date(r.createdAt).toISOString(),\n    ]);\n\n    const csv = [\n      headers.join(','),\n      ...rows.map((row) =&gt; row.map((cell) =&gt; &#96;\"${cell}\"&#96;).join(',')),\n    ].join('\\n');\n\n    return new NextResponse(csv,\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { unlockCreditForRedemption } from '@/lib/credits';\n\nexport async function POST(\n  req: NextRequest,\n  { params }: { params: { id: string } }\n) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.findUnique({\n      where: { id: params.id },\n      include: { merchant: true },\n    });\n\n    if (!redemption) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption not found' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (redemption.confirmedAt) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Redemption already confirmed' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Require merchant staff or admin role\n    await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, redemption.merchantId, 'merchant_staff');\n\n    // Confirm redemption\n    await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      await tx.redemption.update({\n        where: { id: params.id },\n        data: { confirmedAt: new Date(), redeemedByStaffUserId: session.user.id },\n      });\n\n      // Unlock credit if referral exists\n      if (redemption.referralId) {\n        await unlockCreditForRedemption(params.id, redemption.merchantId);\n      }\n    });\n\n    return NextResponse.json({ success: true });\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error confirming redemption:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",
