        "contents": "1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;\n4. **Set secrets**: &#96;fly secrets set KEY=value&#96;\n5. **Deploy**: &#96;fly deploy&#96;\n\n### Self-Hosted (Docker)\n\n1. **Build Docker image**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile\n   FROM node:18-alpine\n   WORKDIR /app\n   COPY package*.json ./\n   RUN npm ci --only=production\n   COPY . .\n   RUN npm run build\n   CMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Run with docker-compose**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n   services:\n     app:\n       build: .\n       ports:\n         - \"3000:3000\"\n       environment:\n         - DATABASE_URL=...\n         - NEXTAUTH_SECRET=...\n       depends_on:\n         - postgres\n         - redis\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Migrations\n\nIn production, use migrations instead of &#96;db:push&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run db:migrate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis creates a migration file that can be reviewed before applying.\n\n## Post-Deployment\n\n1. **Verify health**: Check &#96;/&#96; endpoint\n2. **Test authentication**: Try login flow\n3. **Test voucher creation**: Create a test voucher\n4. **Test redemption flow**: Complete end-to-end test\n5. **Monitor logs**: Check for errors\n6. **Set up monitoring**: Use Sentry, LogRocket, etc.\n\n## Scaling Considerations\n\n- **Database**: Use connection pooling (PgBouncer)\n- **Redis**: Use Redis Cluster for high availability\n- **CDN**: Use Vercel Edge Network or Cloudflare\n- **File Storage**: Use S3-compatible storage for brand assets\n- **Rate Limiting**: Configure Redis-based rate limiting\n- **Caching**: Cache public voucher pages\n\n## Security\n\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] Environment variables secured (never commit to git)\n- [ ] Database credentials rotated regularly\n- [ ] OAuth redirect URIs configured correctly\n- [ ] CORS configured (if needed)\n- [ ] Rate limiting enabled\n- [ ] Audit logging enabled\n\n## Backup Strategy\n\n1. **Database backups**: Daily automated backups\n2. **File backups**: S3 versioning enabled\n3. **Configuration backups**: Store env vars securely\n4. **Test restore**: Regularly test backup restoration\n\n## Monitoring",

        "contents": "### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Revert code deployment\n# 2. Check database migrations (may need to rollback)\n# 3. Verify environment variables\n# 4. Test critical flows\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Launch\n\n### Week 1\n- [ ] Monitor error rates daily\n- [ ] Review user feedback\n- [ ] Check performance metrics\n- [ ] Verify all core flows work\n- [ ] Test on multiple devices/browsers\n\n### Week 2-4",

        "contents": "Use only after a **GO** and when the merchant has seen some results.\n\n&gt; This has been free while we tested.  \n&gt; If we keep this running, it will be a small monthly fee plus a small cost per successful referral.  \n&gt; We can talk numbers when you’re ready — no pressure.\n\n**Do NOT push pricing. Gauge reaction.**\n\n- If positive: *“I’ll send you the options in a couple of days.”*\n- If hesitant: *“No rush. We can run another week or two as is and then decide.”*\n- If no: *“Understood. We’ll turn it off when you prefer. Thanks for trying it.”*\n\n---\n\n## 7. Action Plan — Week by Week\n\nDo in order. Adjust dates to your start.\n\n### Before you start\n\n| # | Task | ✓ |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | List 15–20 candidate businesses (use Section 1 checklist; aim to get 10 IN) | |\n| 2 | Get contact: WhatsApp, phone, or email for owner / decision‑maker | |\n| 3 | Prepare: demo &#96;/v/[id]&#96; and &#96;/r/[id]&#96; live or screens; 10‑min script (Section 2b) | |\n| 4 | Tracker: spreadsheet/notion with columns — Merchant, Category, Go‑live, Vouchers shared, Referrals, Redemptions, Credits earned, Credits used | |\n\n---\n\n### Week 1 — List + outreach\n\n| Day | Task |\n| --- | --- |\n| 1–2 | Run checklist on 15–20; mark IN/OUT. Pick first 5–7 to contact. |\n| 3–5 | DM/call using Section 2. Book 10‑min shows. In‑person best where possible. |\n| 6–7 | Do 10‑min shows. Close: “Want to try for a few weeks?” Aim: 3–5 said yes. |\n\n*If too few yes: add 5 more from list, repeat. Don’t change script yet.*\n\n---\n\n### Week 2 — Setup + go‑live\n\n| Day | Task |\n| --- | --- |\n| 1–3 | Setup sessions (Section 3) with each yes. One session per merchant. |\n| 4–5 | All 10 not reached? — outreach to more from list until you have 10. |\n| 6–7 | Every merchant: 1 voucher live, 1 weekly drop on, staff shown redeem. Log go‑live dates. |\n\n**Rule:** 7 days with zero referrals → tweak offer/credit/drop for that merchant first; don’t change product.\n\n---\n\n### Week 3–4 — Run + 7–10 day feedback\n\n| When | Task |",

        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {

            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n\n\n    if (dayOfWeek !== weeklyDrop.dayOfWeek || now &lt; startTime || now &gt; endTime) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Weekly drop not active' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Atomically check stock and create referral\n    const result = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n      // Count existing referrals for this voucher created in this drop window\n      const existingCount = await tx.referral.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          createdAt: {\n            gte: startTime,\n            lte: endTime,\n          },\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (existingCount &gt;= weeklyDrop.stock) {\n        throw new Error('Weekly drop sold out');\n      }\n\n      // Create referral\n      const friendHash = friendHint\n        ? await hashFriendIdentifier(friendHint)\n        : &#96;anonymous_${Date.now()}_${Math.random()}&#96;;\n\n      const referral = await tx.referral.create({\n        data: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n          referrerUserId: session.user.id,\n          friendHash,\n          status: 'created',\n        },\n      });\n\n      return referral;\n    });\n\n    const shareUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${result.id}&#96;;\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      referralId: result.id,\n      shareUrl,\n      remaining: weeklyDrop.stock - 1, // Approximate\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof z.ZodError) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.errors }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error &amp;&amp; error.message === 'Weekly drop sold out') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: error.message }, { status: 409 });\n    }\n    console.error('Error claiming weekly drop:', error);\n    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { isFeatureEnabled } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Check if weekly drops are enabled for merchant\nconst weeklyDropsEnabled = await isFeatureEnabled(merchantId, 'weeklyDropsEnabled');\n\nif (weeklyDropsEnabled) {\n  // Show weekly drop options\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Set Feature Flags\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Enable weekly drops for a merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'true'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Disable a feature\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = jsonb_set(\n  COALESCE(\"featureFlags\", '{}'::jsonb),\n  '{weeklyDropsEnabled}',\n  'false'::jsonb\n)\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Set multiple flags\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"featureFlags\" = '{\"weeklyDropsEnabled\": true, \"analyticsEnabled\": false}'::jsonb\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Available Feature Flags\n\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; - Enable weekly drop functionality\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; - Enable analytics dashboard (V2)\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled&#96; - Enable custom domains (V2)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled&#96; - Enable white-label mode (V2)\n\n## Integration Points\n\n### Where to Add Kill Switch Checks\n\nAdd &#96;requireActiveMerchant()&#96; checks to:\n\n1. **Voucher Creation** (&#96;app/api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block new vouchers for inactive merchants\n\n2. **Voucher Publishing** (&#96;app/api/vouchers/[id]/publish/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Block publishing for inactive merchants\n\n3. **Public Voucher Pages** (&#96;app/v/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide vouchers from inactive merchants\n\n4. **Public Referral Pages** (&#96;app/r/[id]/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Hide referrals from inactive merchants\n\n5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning",

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Implementation Guide\n\nThis guide explains how to use the launch mode features (kill switch and feature flags) that have been prepared for the platform.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Run the migration to add launch mode fields:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOr manually apply the SQL from &#96;prisma/migrations/launch_mode/migration.sql&#96;\n\n2. Regenerate Prisma client:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpx prisma generate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Kill Switch\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;isActive&#96; field on the &#96;Merchant&#96; model acts as a kill switch. When set to &#96;false&#96;:\n- Merchant is hidden from public routes\n- New voucher creation is blocked\n- Existing redemptions can complete\n- All actions are logged to AuditLog\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Deactivate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { deactivateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Deactivate merchant (requires platform admin)\nawait deactivateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId, 'Reason for deactivation');\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Activate a Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { activateMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\n// Activate merchant\nawait activateMerchant(merchantId, actorUserId);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Check Merchant Status in API Routes\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { requireActiveMerchant } from '@/lib/merchant-status';\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  // ... auth checks ...\n  \n  // Check merchant is active\n  await requireActiveMerchant(merchant.id);\n  \n  // Continue with voucher creation...\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### SQL Direct Access\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Activate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n\n-- Check status\nSELECT id, name, \"isActive\" FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Feature Flags\n\n### How It Works\n\nThe &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.\n\n### Usage\n\n#### Check Feature Flag\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",

          {
            "text": "## Feature Flags",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "### How It Works",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "The &#96;featureFlags&#96; JSON field on &#96;Merchant&#96; stores per-merchant feature flags. This allows enabling/disabling features per merchant without code changes.",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84

            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {

          }

        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
            "line": 69

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "/**\n * Get merchant feature flags\n */\nexport async function getMerchantFeatureFlags(merchantId: string): Promise&lt;Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;&gt; {\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { id: merchantId },\n    select: { featureFlags: true },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    throw new NotFoundError('Merchant not found');\n  }\n\n  if (!merchant.featureFlags) {\n    return {};\n  }\n\n  return merchant.featureFlags as Record&lt;string, boolean&gt;;\n}\n\n/**\n * Check if a specific feature flag is enabled for merchant\n */\nexport async function isFeatureEnabled(\n  merchantId: string,\n  featureName: string\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "import { prisma } from './prisma';\nimport { NotFoundError, ForbiddenError } from './errors';\n\n/**\n * Check if merchant is active (kill switch)\n */\nexport async function isMerchantActive(merchantId: string): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { id: merchantId },\n    select: { isActive: true },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    throw new NotFoundError('Merchant not found');\n  }\n\n  return merchant.isActive ?? true; // Default to true if column doesn't exist yet\n}\n\n/**\n * Require merchant to be active, throw if inactive\n */\nexport async function requireActiveMerchant(merchantId: string): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  const active = await isMerchantActive(merchantId);\n}",

          "endPosition": {

        "contents": "1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions\n3. **Test feature flags** - Verify flags work before enabling for all merchants\n4. **Monitor audit logs** - Track who activated/deactivated merchants\n5. **Graceful degradation** - Inactive merchants should see clear messages, not errors\n\n## Emergency Procedures\n\n### Emergency Deactivation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Immediately deactivate merchant\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'problematic-merchant';\n\n-- This will:\n-- - Block new voucher creation\n-- - Hide from public routes\n-- - Allow existing redemptions to complete\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Reactivation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Reactivate after issue resolved\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = true WHERE \"slug\" = 'problematic-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Next Steps\n\n1. Run migration: &#96;npx prisma migrate dev --name launch_mode&#96;\n2. Integrate &#96;requireActiveMerchant()&#96; into API routes\n3. Add feature flag checks where needed\n4. Test kill switch functionality\n5. Document merchant onboarding process\n6. Set up monitoring/alerts for deactivations",

        "contents": "/**\n * Deactivate merchant (kill switch)\n * Logs action to audit log\n */\nexport async function deactivateMerchant(\n  merchantId: string,\n  actorUserId: string,\n  reason?: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n    // Deactivate merchant\n    await tx.merchant.update({\n      where: { id: merchantId },\n      data: { isActive: false },\n    });\n\n    // Log to audit\n    await tx.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId,\n        actorUserId,\n        action: 'merchant_deactivated',\n        payloadJson: JSON.stringify({ reason }),\n      },\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Activate merchant\n * Logs action to audit log\n */\nexport async function activateMerchant(\n  merchantId: string,\n  actorUserId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",

        "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# V2 Backlog\n\n**DO NOT BUILD** - These features are explicitly forbidden in MVP and should only be documented for future consideration.\n\n## Forbidden Features (Per Specification)\n\n### Marketplace &amp; Discovery\n- ❌ Public marketplace/feed of vouchers\n- ❌ Deals feed\n- ❌ Ad network\n- ❌ Social platform features\n\n### Social Features\n- ❌ Comments on vouchers\n- ❌ Likes/reactions\n- ❌ Social sharing beyond native share sheet\n- ❌ User profiles/public pages\n\n### Loyalty &amp; Tiers\n- ❌ Loyalty tiers/levels\n- ❌ Points systems\n- ❌ Gamification\n\n### AI Features\n- ❌ AI-powered recommendations\n- ❌ AI-generated voucher designs\n- ❌ AI content generation\n\n### Advertising\n- ❌ Ad placements\n- ❌ Sponsored vouchers\n- ❌ Third-party advertising\n\n### Influencer Features\n- ❌ Influencer dashboards\n- ❌ Influencer-specific tools\n- ❌ Creator monetization\n\n## Potential V2 Features (Document Only)\n\nThese were mentioned in the specification as V2 backlog items:\n\n1. **Apple Wallet / Google Wallet**\n   - Add vouchers to native wallet apps\n   - QR codes in wallet format\n\n2. **Push Notifications**\n   - Credit unlock notifications\n   - Redemption confirmations\n   - Weekly drop reminders\n   - Credit expiry warnings\n\n3. **Multi-language Selector**\n   - User-selectable language (beyond browser detection)\n   - Language preferences per user\n\n4. **Custom Domains**\n   - Merchant-branded domains\n   - White-label subdomains\n\n5. **POS Deep Integrations**\n   - Direct POS system integration\n   - Real-time inventory sync\n   - Automated redemption confirmation\n\n6. **Analytics Exports**\n   - PDF reports\n   - CSV exports (already have for redemptions)\n   - Scheduled reports\n\n7. **White-label Mode**\n   - Fully branded merchant experience\n   - Remove platform branding\n   - Custom email templates\n\n## Current Non-MVP Pages (For Reference)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in MVP scope:\n\n- &#96;/admin&#96;         "contents": "/**\n * Activate merchant\n * Logs action to audit log\n */\nexport async function activateMerchant(\n  merchantId: string,\n  actorUserId: string\n): Promise&lt;void&gt; {\n  await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) =&gt; {\n    // Activate merchant\n    await tx.merchant.update({\n      where: { id: merchantId },\n      data: { isActive: true },\n    });\n\n    // Log to audit\n    await tx.auditLog.create({\n      data: {\n        merchantId,\n        actorUserId,\n        action: 'merchant_activated',\n      },\n    });\n  });\n}",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Revert code deployment\n# 2. Check database migrations (may need to rollback)\n# 3. Verify environment variables\n# 4. Test critical flows\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Post-Launch\n\n### Week 1\n- [ ] Monitor error rates daily\n- [ ] Review user feedback\n- [ ] Check performance metrics\n- [ ] Verify all core flows work\n- [ ] Test on multiple devices/browsers\n\n### Week 2-4",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;         "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96;         "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",

- Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;         "contents": "- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s\n- ✅ Share in 1 tap\n- ✅ No signup wall on public pages\n- ✅ Available credit BIG in wallet\n- ✅ Locked credit clearly separated\n- ✅ Expiry visible\n\n### Data Model\nAll required models present:\n- ✅ Merchant\n- ✅ MerchantMember\n- ✅ User\n- ✅ Voucher\n- ✅ Referral\n- ✅ Redemption\n- ✅ CreditLedger\n- ✅ CreditUsage\n- ✅ AuditLog\n\nBusiness rules:\n- ✅ Credit ≠ money\n- ✅ Credit per-merchant\n- ✅ Credit expires (60 days default)\n- ✅ Credit starts LOCKED\n- ✅ Unlock only after redemption confirmation\n- ✅ No self-referral\n- ✅ Weekly drops have fixed stock\n\n### Core Flows (All Working)\n- ✅ **A)** Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ **B)** User shares voucher\n- ✅ **C)** Friend redeems voucher\n- ✅ **D)** Staff confirms redemption\n- ✅ **E)** Credit unlocks\n- ✅ **F)** User applies credit in checkout demo\n\n### Weekly Drops\n- ✅ Optional per voucher\n- ✅ Time window + stock\n- ✅ First come, first served\n- ✅ No notifications in MVP\n\n### Security &amp; Fraud\n- ✅ Rate limits\n- ✅ Device/IP heuristics\n- ✅ Hashed friend identifiers\n- ✅ Audit admin/staff actions\n\n### PWA Requirements\n- ✅ Installable (manifest.json)\n- ✅ Native mobile share\n- ✅ Offline QR for opened vouchers\n- ✅ Works on iOS &amp; Android browsers\n\n### Forbidden Features\n- ✅ No marketplace\n- ✅ No public feeds (except &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; which should be removed)\n- ✅ No comments\n- ✅ No likes\n- ✅ No loyalty tiers\n- ✅ No AI\n- ✅ No ads\n- ✅ No influencer dashboards\n\n## ⚠️ Action Items\n\n### High Priority\n1. **Remove &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; page** - Not in MVP scope per spec\n2. **Hide non-MVP links** - ✅ Done (removed from dashboard)\n\n### Medium Priority\n3. **Verify all 8 done definition steps work locally**\n4. **Test PWA on iOS/Android**\n\n### Low Priority\n5. **Add feature flags to Merchant model** (for launch mode)\n6. **Implement kill switch** (for launch mode)",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;         "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "## Manual Onboarding Flow",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database",
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding",
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "text": "## Kill Switch",
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "To disable a merchant:",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "text": "UPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';",
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "This should:",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "text": "- Hide merchant from public routes",
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "- Prevent new voucher creation",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allow existing redemptions to complete",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "- Log action in AuditLog",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "## No Public Signup",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public merchant signup form",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
            "lineNumber": 69
          }
        ]
      },

        "range": {

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags",

          {

            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "## Features",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "## Tech Stack",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "## Getting Started",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 41

          {
            "text": "- Node.js 18+",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\app\\api\\weekly-drop\\claim\\route.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "column": 56
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 112,
            "column": 1
          }

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { hashFriendIdentifier } from '@/lib/utils';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\n\nconst claimSchema = z.object({\n  voucherId: z.string(),\n  friendHint: z.string().optional(),\n});\n\nexport async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n  try {\n    const session = await auth();\n    if (!session?.user?.id) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 });\n    }\n\n    const body = await req.json();\n    const { voucherId, friendHint } = claimSchema.parse(body);\n\n    // Get voucher with weekly drop info\n    const voucher = await prisma.voucher.findUnique({\n      where: { id: voucherId },\n    });\n\n    if (!voucher || !voucher.weeklyDropEnabled) {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not found or weekly drop not enabled' }, { status: 404 });\n    }\n\n    if (voucher.status !== 'published') {\n      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher not available' }, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    const weeklyDrop = voucher.weeklyDropJson\n      ?         "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",

        "contents": "export default async function MerchantDashboardPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\nconst [\n    activeVouchers,\n    activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await \n\n\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Revenue: sum of paid voucher purchases\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Outstanding liability: sum of voucher values for paid but unredeemed purchases\n    // We need to calculate this differently - sum of voucher.value where purchase is paid but not redeemed\n    prisma.voucherPurchase.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n        voucher: {\n          redemptions: {\n            none: {\n              confirmedAt: { not: null },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { value: true },\n        },\n      },\n    }),\n    // Ticket revenue: sum of paid ticket purchases\n    prisma.ticketPurchase.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'paid',\n      },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    // Tickets sold count\n    prisma.ticket.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['sold', 'used'] },\n      },\n    }),\n  ]);\n}",

        "contents": "import { startOfDay, startOfWeek } from 'date-fns';\nimport { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from redirect('/login');\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({ where: { slug: params.slug } });\n  if (!merchant) notFound();\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, activeCampaigns,\n    activeEvents,\n    redemptionsToday,\n    redemptionsThisWeek,\n    redemptionCount,\n    pendingRedemptions,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    totalRevenue,\n    outstandingLiability,\n    ticketRevenue,\n    ticketsSold,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.voucher.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.campaign.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'active' } }),\n    prisma.event.count({ where: { merchantId: merchant.id, status: 'published' } }),\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n prisma.voucherPurchase.aggregate\n\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function AnalyticsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get analytics data\n  const [\n    totalRedemptions,\n    totalRevenue,\n    totalCreditsIssued,\n    topVouchers,\n    recentRedemptions,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.redemption.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.aggregate({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      _sum: {\n        discountApplied: true,\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.creditLedger.aggregate({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _sum: { amount: true },\n    }),\n    prisma.voucher.findMany({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      include: {\n        _count: {\n          select: {\n            redemptions: {\n              where: { confirmedAt: { not: null } },\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: {\n        redemptions: {\n          _count: 'desc',\n        },\n      },\n      take: 5,\n    }),\n    prisma.redemption.findMany({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        confirmedAt: { not: null },\n      },\n      include: {\n        voucher: {\n          select: { id: true, type: true },\n        },\n      },\n      orderBy: { confirmedAt: 'desc' },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

Math.min(100, (used / limit) * 100) : null;\n\n              return (\n                &lt;Card key={voucher.id}&gt;\n                  &lt;CardHeader className=\"pb-2\"&gt;\n                    &lt;div className=\"flex justify-between items-start gap-2\"&gt;\n                      &lt;CardTitle className=\"text-lg font-semibold truncate\"&gt;{headline}&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n                      &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0\"&gt;\n                        &lt;Badge variant={statusVariant[voucher.status] || 'muted'}&gt;\n                          {statusLabel[voucher.status] || voucher.status}\n                        &lt;/Badge&gt;\n                        &lt;VoucherRowActions\n                          slug={params.slug}\n                          voucherId={voucher.id}\n                          status={voucher.status as 'draft' | 'published' | 'paused' | 'ended'}\n                        /&gt;\n                      &lt;/div&gt;\n                    &lt;/div&gt;\n                    &lt;CardDescription&gt;\n                      {voucher.type} · {voucher.currency}\n                    &lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n                  &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n                  &lt;CardContent className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n                    {limit != null ?         "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\n\nexport default async function MembersPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n    include: {\n      members: {\n        include: {\n          user: {\n            select: {\n              id: true,\n              email: true,\n              name: true,\n            },\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_admin');\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { auth } from '@/lib/auth';\nimport { prisma } from '@/lib/prisma';\nimport { requireMerchantRole } from '@/lib/rbac';\nimport { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/components/ui/card';\nimport { formatCurrency } from '@/lib/utils';\n\nexport default async function ReferralsPage({ params }: { params: { slug: string } }) {\n  const session = await auth();\n  if (!session?.user?.id) {\n    redirect('/login');\n  }\n\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.findUnique({\n    where: { slug: params.slug },\n  });\n\n  if (!merchant) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  await requireMerchantRole(session.user.id, merchant.id, 'merchant_staff');\n\n  // Get referral analytics\n  const [\n    totalReferrals,\n    openedReferrals,\n    redeemedReferrals,\n    topReferrers,\n    referralStats,\n  ] = await Promise.all([\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: { in: ['opened', 'redeemed'] },\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.count({\n      where: {\n        merchantId: merchant.id,\n        status: 'redeemed',\n      },\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['referrerUserId'],\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _count: { id: true },\n      orderBy: { _count: { id: 'desc' } },\n      take: 10,\n    }),\n    prisma.referral.groupBy({\n      by: ['status'],\n      where: { merchantId: merchant.id },\n      _count: { id: true },\n    }),\n  ]);\n\n  // Get user details for top referrers\n  const topReferrerIds = topReferrers.map((r) =&gt; r.referrerUserId);\n  const topReferrerUsers = await prisma.user.findMany({\n    where: { id: { in: topReferrerIds } },\n    select: { id: true, name: true, email: true },\n  });\n\n  const conversionRate = totalReferrals &gt; 0\n    ? ((redeemedReferrals / totalReferrals) * 100).toFixed(1)\n    : '0.0';\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export default function NewVoucherPage() {\nconst handleSubmit = async \nconst body = {\n\n        weeklyDropEnabled: formData.weeklyDropEnabled,\n        weeklyDropJson,\n        designJson,\n        codePrefix: formData.codePrefix || undefined,\n      };\n\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${merchantSlug}/vouchers&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify(body),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const d = await res.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n        throw new Error(d.error || 'Failed to create voucher');\n      }\n      const voucher = await res.json();\n      router.push(&#96;/merchant/${merchantSlug}/vouchers/${voucher.id}&#96;);\n    } catch (e) {\n      showError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : t('success.failedToCreateVoucher'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"p-4 sm:p-6\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"max-w-6xl mx-auto\"&gt;\n        &lt;Breadcrumbs\n          items={[\n            { label: tNav('dashboard'), href: &#96;/merchant/${merchantSlug}/dashboard&#96; },\n            { label: tNav('vouchers'), href: &#96;/merchant/${merchantSlug}/vouchers&#96; },\n            { label: tVoucher('create') },\n          ]}\n        /&gt;\n        &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-4 mb-6\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { LoadingButton } from '@/components/ui/loading-button';\nimport { showSuccess, showError } from '@/lib/toast-helpers';\n\nexport default function PublishVoucherButton({ voucherId }: { voucherId: string }) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handlePublish = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('Publish this voucher? It will be visible to the public.')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucherId}/publish&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        const error = await response.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || 'Failed to publish voucher');\n      }\n\n      router.refresh();\n      showSuccess('Voucher published successfully!');\n    } catch (error: any) {\n      showError(error.message || 'Failed to publish voucher');\n      console.error(error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;LoadingButton onClick={handlePublish} loading={isLoading} loadingText=\"Publishing...\"&gt;\n      Publish Voucher\n    &lt;/LoadingButton&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export function VoucherRowActions({ slug, voucherId, status }: VoucherRowActionsProps) {\n\n\n  const handleDuplicate = async () =&gt; {\n    setDuplicating(true);\n    try {\n      const getRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${voucherId}&#96;);\n      if (!getRes.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load voucher');\n      const v = await getRes.json();\n\n      const parse = (x: unknown) =&gt; (typeof x === 'string' ? JSON.parse(x) : x ?? undefined);\n      const designJson = v.designJson != null ? parse(v.designJson) : undefined;\n      const weeklyDropJson = v.weeklyDropJson != null ? parse(v.weeklyDropJson) : undefined;\n      const conditionsJson = v.conditionsJson != null ? parse(v.conditionsJson) : undefined;\n\n      const body = {\n        type: v.type,\n        value: v.value,\n        currency: v.currency,\n        validFrom: new Date(v.validFrom).toISOString(),\n        validTo: new Date(v.validTo).toISOString(),\n        usageLimitTotal: v.usageLimitTotal ?? undefined,\n        usageLimitPerUser: v.usageLimitPerUser ?? undefined,\n        weeklyDropEnabled: v.weeklyDropEnabled ?? false,\n        weeklyDropJson: weeklyDropJson ?? undefined,\n        conditionsJson: conditionsJson ?? undefined,\n        designJson,\n        codePrefix: v.codePrefix ?? undefined,\n      };\n\n      const postRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify(body),\n      });\n      if (!postRes.ok) {\n        const d = await postRes.json().catch(() =&gt; ({}));\n        throw new Error(d.error || 'Failed to duplicate');\n      }\n      const created = await postRes.json();\n      showSuccess('Voucher duplicated');\n      router.push(&#96;/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${created.id}&#96;);\n    } catch (e) {\n      showError(e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Failed to duplicate');\n    } finally {\n      setDuplicating(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex items-center gap-1\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VoucherRowActions({ slug, voucherId, status }: VoucherRowActionsProps) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const [pausing, setPausing] = useState(false);\n  const [duplicating, setDuplicating] = useState(false);\n\n  const handlePause = async () =&gt; {\n    setPausing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${voucherId}&#96;, {\n        method: 'PUT',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({ status: 'paused' }),\n      });\n      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to pause');\n      showSuccess('Voucher paused');\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch {\n      showError('Failed to pause voucher');\n    } finally {\n      setPausing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleDuplicate = async () =&gt; {\n    setDuplicating(true);\n    try {\n      const getRes = await fetch(&#96;/api/merchant/${slug}/vouchers/${voucherId}&#96;);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\nconst redemption = await ({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId: session?.user?.id || null,\n        method: data.method,\n        orderReference: data.orderReference,\n        amountBeforeDiscount: data.amountBeforeDiscount,\n        discountApplied: data.discountApplied,\n        currency: data.currency,\n        confirmedAt: null,\n      },\n    });\n\n    // If there's a referral, create locked credit\n    if (data.referralId) {\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n        include: { referrer: true },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        // Calculate credit amount (for MVP, use a fixed percentage or voucher value)\n        let creditAmount = 0;\n        if (voucher.type === 'credit_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value;\n        } else if (voucher.type === 'fixed_amount') {\n          creditAmount = voucher.value; // Same as discount\n        } else {\n          // Percentage: give 10% of discount as credit (configurable)\n          creditAmount = Math.floor(data.discountApplied * 0.1);\n        }\n\n        if (creditAmount &gt; 0) {\n          const expiresAt = new Date();\n          expiresAt.setDate(expiresAt.getDate() + 60); // Default 60 days\n\n          await prisma.creditLedger.create({\n            data: {\n              merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n              userId: referral.referrerUserId,\n              amount: creditAmount,\n              currency: voucher.currency,\n              status: 'locked',\n              source: 'referral_redemption',\n              sourceId: redemption.id,\n              expiresAt,\n            },\n          });\n\n          // Update referral status\n          await prisma.referral.update({\n            where: { id: data.referralId },\n            data: { status: 'redeemed' },\n          });\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    return NextResponse.json({\n      redemptionId: redemption.id,\n      requiresConfirmation: data.method === 'in_store',\n    });\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "'use client';\n\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\n\nexport default function ConfirmRedemptionButton({\n  redemptionId,\n  merchantSlug,\n}: {\n  redemptionId: string;\n  merchantSlug: string;\n}) {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleConfirm = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!confirm('Confirm this redemption? This will unlock credit for the referrer.')) {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(&#96;/api/redemptions/${redemptionId}/confirm&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n      });\n\n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to confirm redemption');\n      }\n\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (error) {\n      alert('Failed to confirm redemption');\n      console.error(error);\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button onClick={handleConfirm} disabled={isLoading}&gt;\n      {isLoading ? 'Confirming...' : 'Confirm Redemption'}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "- Check usage limits\n- Check self-referral prevention\n- Check rate limits\n\n### Credit not unlocking\n- Check redemption is confirmed: &#96;SELECT \"confirmedAt\" FROM \"Redemption\" WHERE id = '[id]';&#96;\n- Check credit exists: &#96;SELECT * FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE \"sourceId\" = '[redemptionId]';&#96;\n- Check unlock function was called\n\n### Credit not applying\n- Check credit is available: &#96;SELECT status FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE id = '[id]';&#96;\n- Check balance is sufficient\n- Check API response for errors\n\n## Quick Test Script\n\nFor automated testing, you can use this SQL to verify all steps:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Step 1: Voucher exists and is published\nSELECT id, status FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 2: Referral created\nSELECT id, \"referrerUserId\", status FROM \"Referral\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 4: Redemption created\nSELECT id, \"referralId\", \"confirmedAt\" FROM \"Redemption\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 5: Credit locked\nSELECT id, status, amount FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE status = 'locked' ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 7: Credit unlocked\nSELECT id, status FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE status = 'available' ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 8: Credit used\nSELECT id, \"amountUsed\" FROM \"CreditUsage\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Success Criteria\n\nAll 8 steps should complete without errors:\n- ✅ Voucher page loads\n- ✅ Referral created\n- ✅ Link shareable\n- ✅ Friend redeems\n- ✅ Staff confirms\n- ✅ Credit appears locked\n- ✅ Credit unlocks\n- ✅ Credit applied\n\nIf all steps pass, **MVP is DONE** ✅",

        "contents": "export async function POST(req: NextRequest) {\n, { status: 400 });\n    }\n\n    // Check usage limits\n    if (voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n      const totalRedemptions = await prisma.redemption.count({\n        where: {\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          confirmedAt: { not: null },\n        },\n      });\n      if (totalRedemptions &gt;= voucher.usageLimitTotal) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Voucher usage limit reached' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // If referral exists, check self-referral and rate limits\n    if (data.referralId &amp;&amp; session?.user?.id) {\n      const isSelf = await isSelfReferral(data.referralId, session.user.id);\n      if (isSelf) {\n        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Cannot redeem your own referral' }, { status: 400 });\n      }\n\n      const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n        where: { id: data.referralId },\n      });\n\n      if (referral) {\n        const rateLimit = await checkRedemptionRateLimit(referral.friendHash);\n        if (!rateLimit.allowed) {\n          return NextResponse.json(\n            { error: 'Rate limit exceeded', remaining: rateLimit.remaining },\n            { status: 429 }\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Create redemption (unconfirmed initially)\n    const redemption = await prisma.redemption.create({\n      data: {\n        voucherId: voucher.id,\n        merchantId: voucher.merchantId,\n        referralId: data.referralId,\n        redeemedByUserId:\n;\n}",
