            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Go to checkout demo**:",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "text": "   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Should show available credit balance",
            "lineNumber": 164
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 165
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Enter order amount**:",
            "lineNumber": 166
          },
          {
            "text": "   - E.g., 50 (in major units, will be converted to minor)",
            "lineNumber": 167
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 168
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Click \"Apply Credit &amp; Complete Order\"**:",
            "lineNumber": 169
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Should call &#96;/api/credits/apply&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Should show success message",
            "lineNumber": 171
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Should update credit balance",
            "lineNumber": 172
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173
          },
          {
            "text": "**Expected**: Credit applied, order completed, credit balance updated.",
            "lineNumber": 174
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "text": "**Verify in database**:",
            "lineNumber": 176
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 177
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Check credit usage",
            "lineNumber": 178
          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT id, \"amountUsed\", \"creditLedgerIds\" FROM \"CreditUsage\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;",
            "lineNumber": 179
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Check credit ledger updated",
            "lineNumber": 181
          },
          {
            "text": "SELECT id, status FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE id = ANY('[creditLedgerIds]');",
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "text": "-- Status should be 'used'",
            "lineNumber": 183
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 184
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 186
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "text": "## Troubleshooting",
            "lineNumber": 188
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "text": "### Voucher not found",
            "lineNumber": 190
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check voucher exists: &#96;SELECT id, status FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE id = '[id]';&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 191
          },
          {
            "text": "- Voucher must be &#96;published&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 192
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193
          },
          {
            "text": "### Referral not created",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check user is logged in",
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check voucher is published",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check rate limits: &#96;SELECT COUNT(*) FROM \"Referral\" WHERE \"referrerUserId\" = '[userId]' AND \"createdAt\" &gt; NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour';&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "### Redemption fails",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check voucher is published and valid",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check usage limits",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check self-referral prevention",
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "- Check rate limits",
            "lineNumber": 203
          }
        ]

        "contents": "# Quick Start Guide\n\n## Ühe käsuga (soovitus) — &#96;dev:full&#96;\n\nKui Docker Desktop on käivitatud:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee käivitab: Postgres, loob/värskendab &#96;.env.local&#96;, teeb &#96;db push&#96;, &#96;db:seed&#96; ja &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;, siis dev-serveri.\n\n**Testikasutaja:** &#96;test@example.com&#96; / &#96;test123&#96;  \n**Lehed:** &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → /app (Coffee House: Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard)\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ installed\n- Docker Desktop installed and running\n- Git (optional)\n\n## Setup Steps\n\n1. **Install dependencies**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set up environment**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Copy the example env file\n   # Edit .env and set:\n   # - AUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - NEXTAUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - DATABASE_URL (already set for Docker)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Start database and initialize**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended)\n   npm run db:setup\n   \n   # Or manually:\n   npm run db:check      # Check Docker Desktop\n   npm run docker:up     # Start containers\n   npm run db:wait       # Wait for database\n   npm run db:push       # Push schema\n   npm run db:seed       # Seed data\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Start development server**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Open browser**:\n   Navigate to &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt;\n\n## Test the Flow\n\n1. **View a voucher** (after creating one):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&gt;\n   - Replace [voucherId] with an actual voucher ID from your database\n   - Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Login** (e‑post + parool):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt;\n   - [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) / **test123** (Credentials; töötab kohe kui &#96;dev:full&#96; või &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; on käivitatud)\n   - Või [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com) — magic link (vajab SMTP) või OAuth\n\n3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;",

        "contents": "{\n  \"name\": \"voucher-platform\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"private\": true,\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"dev\": \"next dev\",\n    \"dev:clean\": \"node -e \\\"require('fs').rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true})\\\" &amp;&amp; next dev\",\n    \"dev:all\": \"npm run dev:full\",\n    \"dev:full\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev-full.ps1\",\n    \"build\": \"node scripts/build.cjs\",\n    \"build:next\": \"next build\",\n    \"start\": \"next start\",\n    \"lint\": \"next lint\",\n    \"docker:up\": \"docker compose up -d\",\n    \"docker:down\": \"docker compose down\",\n    \"docker:logs\": \"docker compose logs -f\",\n    \"db:check\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-docker.ps1\",\n    \"db:wait\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/wait-for-db.ps1\",\n    \"db:setup\": \"npm run db:check &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up &amp;&amp; timeout /t 5 /nobreak &gt;nul 2&gt;&amp;1 || node -e \\\"const d=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-d&lt;5000);\\\" &amp;&amp; npm run db:wait &amp;&amp; npm run db:push &amp;&amp; npm run db:seed\",\n    \"db:push\": \"prisma db push\",\n    \"db:migrate\": \"prisma migrate dev\",\n    \"db:seed\": \"tsx prisma/seed.ts\",\n    \"db:ensure-test-user\": \"tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts\",\n    \"db:studio\": \"prisma studio\",\n    \"test\": \"vitest\",\n    \"test:ui\": \"vitest --ui\",\n    \"test:e2e\": \"playwright test\",\n    \"test:e2e:ui\": \"playwright test --ui\",",

        "contents": "# Full dev startup: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed/ensure-test-user, dev server\n# Run: npm run dev:full\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"..\")).Path\nSet-Location $root\n\ndocker info 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] Docker ei käivitu. Käivita Docker Desktop ja proovi: npm run dev:full\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n$localUrl = \"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db\"\n$authSecret = \"voucher-dev-secret-min-32-chars-long\"\n$envLocalPath = Join-Path $root \".env.local\"\n\n# 1) .env.local (local Postgres + AUTH_SECRET, et Next.js ja auth töötaks)\n@\"\n# Local Docker Postgres (dev:full)\nDATABASE_URL=\"$localUrl\"\nAUTH_SECRET=\"$authSecret\"\n\"@ | Set-Content -Path $envLocalPath -Encoding utf8 -Force\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] .env.local ok\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 2) Docker Postgres\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting Postgres...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\ndocker compose up -d postgres 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Waiting for DB...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; \"$PSScriptRoot\\wait-for-db.ps1\" -MaxAttempts 30 -DelaySeconds 2\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] DB not ready. Check: docker compose logs postgres\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n# 3) Prisma + seed (DATABASE_URL for Prisma CLI)\n$env:DATABASE_URL = $localUrl\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] prisma db push...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpx prisma db push\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:seed (may fail if data exists)...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:seed 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:ensure-test-user...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:ensure-test-user\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] ensure-test-user ebaõnnestus\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Test: test@example.com / test123\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting dev server...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpm run dev",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = referral.voucher.designJson\n    ? (JSON.parse(referral.voucher.designJson as string) as Record&lt;string, any&gt;)\n    : null;\n\n  const brandColors = referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson\n    ? (JSON.parse(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson as string) as Record&lt;string, string&gt;)\n    : null;\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n}",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "Ei mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena\n\nKui UI on ilus, aga aeglane → vale.\n\n## 8) PWA REEGLID\n\nInstallitav\n\nNative share (mobile)\n\nOffline QR juba avatud voucheritele\n\niOS &amp; Android browser support\n\n## 9) LOGGING &amp; AUDIT\n\nKõik admin/staff tegevused → AuditLog\n\nÄra logi tundlikke andmeid\n\nRiskisündmused märgista (fraud flags)\n\n## 10) DONE DEFINITSIOON (ABSOLUUTNE)\n\nMVP on DONE, kui lokaalselt seed’iga:\n\nAvan voucheri\n\nLoon referral’i\n\nJagan linki\n\nFriend redeem’ib\n\nStaff kinnitab\n\nCredit tekib locked\n\nCredit unlock’itakse\n\nCredit kasutatakse demo checkout’is\n\nKui üks samm ei tööta → NOT DONE.\n\n## 11) KEEELUD (AUTOMAATNE STOPP)\n\nCursor EI TOHI:\n\nlisada uusi lehti\n\nlisada uusi rolle\n\nlisada uusi tasemeid\n\nlisada analytics’e “niisama”\n\n“parandada UX-i” scope’i laiendades\n\nKui tekib kiusatus → kirjuta V2 backlog’isse, ära ehita.\n\n## 12) BUILD ORDER (JÄRGI)\n\nPrisma schema + migrations\n\nAuth + RBAC + tenancy\n\nPublic voucher &amp; referral pages\n\nMerchant voucher builder\n\nRedemption + credit pipeline\n\nWallet UI\n\nPWA polish\n\nTests + seed + docs\n\n## 13) SUHTLUSREEGEL\n\nKui midagi on ebaselge → küsi\n\nKui miski ei mahu MVP-sse → ära tee\n\nKui reegel on vastuolus ideega → idee kaotab\n\n## 14) FILOSOOFIA\n\nSee projekt ei võida müraga.\nSee võidab selguse, distsipliini ja usaldusega.\n\nBuild infrastructure.\nNot hype.",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Audit\n\n## ✅ MVP Pages (Required &amp; Present)\n\n### PUBLIC\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page  \n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n### USER\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ⚠️ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/vouchers&#96; - User vouchers (not explicitly in spec, but useful for flow B)\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo (required for flow F)\n\n### MERCHANT\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n## ⚠️ Non-MVP Pages (Present but Not in Scope)\n\nThese pages exist but are NOT in the MVP specification:\n\n1. **&#96;/admin&#96;** - Platform admin dashboard\n   - Status: Present, minimal implementation\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but document as internal-only\n\n2. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96;** - Analytics dashboard\n   - Status: Present with charts/stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n3. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96;** - Referral analytics\n   - Status: Present with referral stats\n   - Action: **REMOVE or hide** - Not in MVP scope\n\n4. **&#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;** - Member management\n   - Status: Present, minimal\n   - Action: Keep for launch mode (manual onboarding), but hide from navigation\n\n5. **&#96;/m/[slug]&#96;** - Public merchant landing page\n   - Status: Present, shows merchant vouchers\n   - Action: **REMOVE** - Not in MVP scope (spec says \"NO OTHER PAGES\")\n\n## ✅ Core Flows Verification\n\n### A) Merchant creates voucher → publish\n- ✅ Voucher builder at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n- ✅ Publish endpoint: &#96;/api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working\n\n### B) User shares voucher\n- ✅ Share button on &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n- ✅ Creates referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n- ✅ Generates share URL &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n- ✅ Status: Working",

        "contents": "async function generateQRCode(text: string): Promise&lt;string&gt; {\n\n}\n\nexport default async function ReferralPage({ params }: { params: { id: string } }) {\n  const referral = await prisma.referral.findUnique({\n    where: { id: params.id },\n    include: {\n      voucher: {\n        include: { merchant: true },\n      },\n      referrer: {\n        select: { name: true, email: true },\n      },\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (!referral || referral.voucher.status !== 'published') {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  // Check merchant is active (kill switch) - hide inactive merchants from public\n  const isActive = await isMerchantActive(referral.voucher.merchantId);\n  if (!isActive) {\n    notFound();\n  }\n\n  const session = await auth();\n  const design = referral.voucher.designJson\n    ? (JSON.parse(referral.voucher.designJson as string) as Record&lt;string, any&gt;)\n    : null;\n\n  const brandColors = referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson\n    ? (JSON.parse(referral.voucher.merchant.brandColorsJson as string) as Record&lt;string, string&gt;)\n    : null;\n\n  // Generate voucher code\n  const voucherCode = &#96;${referral.voucher.codePrefix || 'V'}-${referral.voucher.id.slice(0, 8).toUpperCase()}&#96;;\n  const referralUrl = &#96;${process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL}/r/${referral.id}&#96;;\n  const qrCodeDataUrl = await generateQRCode(referralUrl);\n\n  // Update referral status to 'opened' if it's still 'created'\n  if (referral.status === 'created') {\n    await prisma.referral.update({\n      where: { id: referral.id },\n      data: { status: 'opened' },\n    });\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;ReferralClient\n      referral={referral}\n      voucher={referral.voucher}\n      design={design}\n      brandColors={brandColors}\n      voucherCode={voucherCode}\n      qrCodeDataUrl={qrCodeDataUrl}\n      isAuthenticated={!!session?.user}\n}",

        "contents": "interface VoucherClientProps {\n;\n  voucherCode: string;\n  qrCodeDataUrl: string;\n  isAuthenticated: boolean;\n  campaign?: any;\n}\n\nexport default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n  const [isSharing, setIsSharing] = useState(false);\n  const [got, setGot] = useState(false);\n  const [isPurchasing, setIsPurchasing] = useState(false);\n  const t = useTranslations('payment');\n  const tVoucher = useTranslations('voucher');\n  const tCommon = useTranslations('common');\n  const tSuccess = useTranslations('success');\n\n  const brandBg = brandColors?.background || design?.backgroundColor || '#fafafa';\n  const brandPrimary = brandColors?.primary || design?.primaryColor || '#18181b';\n  \n  const hasPrice = campaign?.price !== null &amp;&amp; campaign?.price !== undefined;\n  const price = campaign?.price || 0;\n\n  const handleGet = async () =&gt; {\n    await navigator.clipboard.writeText(voucherCode);\n    showSuccess(t('codeCopied'));\n    setGot(true);\n    setTimeout(() =&gt; setGot(false), 1500);\n  };\n\n  const handlePurchase = async () =&gt; {\n    if (!isAuthenticated) {\n      window.location.href = &#96;/login?callbackUrl=${encodeURIComponent(window.location.href)}&#96;;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    setIsPurchasing(true);\n    try {\n      const res = await fetch(&#96;/api/vouchers/${voucher.id}/purchase&#96;, {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({}),\n      });\n\n      if (!res.ok) {\n        const error = await res.json();\n        throw new Error(error.error || t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n\n      const data = await res.json();\n      if (data.url) {\n        window.location.href = data.url;\n      } else {\n        throw new Error(t('purchaseFailed'));\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      showError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : t('purchaseFailed'));\n      setIsPurchasing(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

        "contents": "# MVP Compliance Report\n\n## ✅ Specification Compliance\n\n### Product Identity\n- ✅ Infrastructure for merchants (NOT marketplace/deals feed)\n- ✅ Merchant-powered referral system\n- ✅ Customers as distribution channel\n\n### Core Value Proposition\n- ✅ Merchants create brand-owned vouchers\n- ✅ Pay only for real redemptions\n- ✅ Users share vouchers easily\n- ✅ Friends redeem without signup\n- ✅ Users earn merchant credit\n\n### Tech Stack\n- ✅ Next.js App Router\n- ✅ React + TypeScript\n- ✅ TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui\n- ✅ PWA (manifest + service worker)\n- ✅ next-intl (EN default, 13 languages)\n- ✅ NextAuth (Magic link + Google + Apple)\n- ✅ PostgreSQL + Prisma\n- ✅ Redis (optional for local)\n- ✅ Docker Compose\n\n### User Roles\n- ✅ anonymous, user, merchant_staff, merchant_admin, platform_admin\n- ✅ Public pages NEVER require login\n- ✅ Merchant routes ALWAYS require role\n- ✅ Users see only own wallet &amp; vouchers\n\n### MVP UI Scope\n**PUBLIC:**\n- ✅ &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96; - Public voucher page\n- ✅ &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96; - Public referral page\n- ✅ &#96;/login&#96; - Login page\n\n**USER:**\n- ✅ &#96;/app&#96; - User home\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchant]/wallet&#96; - Credit wallet\n- ✅ &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96; - Checkout demo\n\n**MERCHANT:**\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/dashboard&#96; - Dashboard\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Voucher list\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96; - Voucher builder\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96; - Redemptions\n- ✅ &#96;/merchant/[slug]/settings&#96; - Settings\n\n**Non-MVP (Documented):**\n- &#96;/admin&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/analytics&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/referrals&#96; - V2 feature (hidden from nav)\n- &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; - Internal use (launch mode)\n- &#96;/m/[slug]&#96; - Public merchant page (should be removed per spec)\n\n### UI Look &amp; Feel\n- ✅ Premium, calm, confident design\n- ✅ Mobile-first responsive\n- ✅ One primary CTA per screen\n- ✅ Merchant brand dominates platform brand\n- ✅ Voucher value visible &lt;3s",

        "contents": "- Check usage limits\n- Check self-referral prevention\n- Check rate limits\n\n### Credit not unlocking\n- Check redemption is confirmed: &#96;SELECT \"confirmedAt\" FROM \"Redemption\" WHERE id = '[id]';&#96;\n- Check credit exists: &#96;SELECT * FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE \"sourceId\" = '[redemptionId]';&#96;\n- Check unlock function was called\n\n### Credit not applying\n- Check credit is available: &#96;SELECT status FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE id = '[id]';&#96;\n- Check balance is sufficient\n- Check API response for errors\n\n## Quick Test Script\n\nFor automated testing, you can use this SQL to verify all steps:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Step 1: Voucher exists and is published\nSELECT id, status FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 2: Referral created\nSELECT id, \"referrerUserId\", status FROM \"Referral\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 4: Redemption created\nSELECT id, \"referralId\", \"confirmedAt\" FROM \"Redemption\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 5: Credit locked\nSELECT id, status, amount FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE status = 'locked' ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 7: Credit unlocked\nSELECT id, status FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE status = 'available' ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Step 8: Credit used\nSELECT id, \"amountUsed\" FROM \"CreditUsage\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Success Criteria\n\nAll 8 steps should complete without errors:\n- ✅ Voucher page loads\n- ✅ Referral created\n- ✅ Link shareable\n- ✅ Friend redeems\n- ✅ Staff confirms\n- ✅ Credit appears locked\n- ✅ Credit unlocks\n- ✅ Credit applied\n\nIf all steps pass, **MVP is DONE** ✅",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\n\n\n  const handleShare = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsSharing(true);\n    let url = window.location.href;\n    if (isAuthenticated) {\n      try {\n        const res = await fetch('/api/referrals/create', {\n          method: 'POST',\n          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n          body: JSON.stringify({ voucherId: voucher.id }),\n        });\n        const data = await res.json();\n        if (data.shareUrl) url = data.shareUrl;\n      } catch {\n        // use /v/ link as fallback\n      }\n    }\n    if (navigator.share) {\n      try {\n        await navigator.share({\n          title: design?.headline || tVoucher('specialOffer'),\n          text: &#96;${tVoucher('checkOutVoucher')} ${voucher.merchant.name}&#96;,\n          url,\n        });\n        showSuccess(tVoucher('linkShared'));\n      } catch {\n        // cancelled or error\n      }\n    } else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo(tVoucher('linkCopied'));\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export default function ReferralClient({\n  referral,\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isSelfReferral,\n}: ReferralClientProps) {\n\n\n  const calculateDiscount = (amount: number) =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') {\n      return Math.floor((amount * voucher.value) / 10000);\n    }\n    return Math.min(voucher.value, amount);\n  };\n\n  const handleRedeem = async (method: 'online' | 'in_store') =&gt; {\n    if (isSelfReferral) {\n      setError(tReferral('cannotRedeemOwn'));\n      return;\n    }\n    setIsRedeeming(true);\n    setError('');\n    try {\n      const amount = method === 'online' ? parseInt(orderAmount, 10) * 100 : 10000;\n      const discount = calculateDiscount(amount);\n      const response = await fetch('/api/redemptions', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify({\n          voucherId: voucher.id,\n          referralId: referral.id,\n          method,\n          amountBeforeDiscount: amount,\n          discountApplied: discount,\n          currency: voucher.currency,\n        }),\n      });\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.error || tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n      if (method === 'in_store') {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('showQrToStaff'));\n        qrRef.current?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });\n      } else {\n        showSuccess(tReferral('discountApplied', { amount: formatCurrency(discount, voucher.currency) }));\n      }\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err: unknown) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : tReferral('redemptionFailed'));\n    } finally {\n      setIsRedeeming(false);\n    }\n  };\n}",

        "contents": "export default function VoucherClient({\n  voucher,\n  design,\n  brandColors,\n  voucherCode,\n  qrCodeDataUrl,\n  isAuthenticated,\n  campaign,\n}: VoucherClientProps) {\nconst handleShare = async \n else {\n      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);\n      showInfo(tVoucher('linkCopied'));\n    }\n    setIsSharing(false);\n  };\n\n  const getVoucherValue = () =&gt; {\n    if (voucher.type === 'percentage') return formatPercentage(voucher.value);\n    return formatCurrency(voucher.value, voucher.currency);\n  };\n\n  const headline = design?.headline || tVoucher('specialOffer');\n  const limitText = voucher.usageLimitTotal\n    ? &#96; · ${tVoucher('firstUses', { count: voucher.usageLimitTotal })}&#96;\n    : '';\n\n  const scope = &#96;voucher-theme-${String(voucher.id).replace(/\\s/g, '')}&#96;;\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={&#96;${scope} min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 bg-[var(--brand-bg)]&#96;}&gt;\n      &lt;style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: &#96;.${scope}{--brand-bg:${brandBg};--brand-primary:${brandPrimary}}&#96; }} /&gt;\n      &lt;Card className=\"w-full max-w-[400px] shadow-lg shadow-black/5 border-transparent\"&gt;\n        {/* Brand + value block */}\n        &lt;div className=\"rounded-t-lg px-6 pt-6 pb-5 bg-[var(--brand-primary)] text-white\"&gt;\n          {voucher.merchant.brandLogoUrl &amp;&amp; (\n            &lt;Image\n              src={voucher.merchant.brandLogoUrl}\n              alt=\"\"\n              width={160}\n              height={40}\n              className=\"h-10 w-auto object-contain mb-4\"\n              unoptimized\n            /&gt;\n          )}\n          &lt;p className=\"text-sm font-medium text-white/80\"&gt;{voucher.merchant.name}&lt;/p&gt;\n          &lt;h1 className=\"text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-semibold mt-1 tracking-tight\"&gt;\n            {headline}\n          &lt;/h1&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"mt-3 text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-semibold tabular-nums\"&gt;\n            {getVoucherValue()}\n          &lt;/p&gt;\n        &lt;/div&gt;\n\n        &lt;CardContent className=\"p-6 pt-5 space-y-5\"&gt;\n          &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;\n   - Fill in the form and create a voucher\n\n4. **Share voucher**:\n   - View the voucher at &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96; to check Docker status\n- Start Docker Desktop manually from Start Menu\n- See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md][troubleshooting] for detailed solutions\n\n**Database connection error**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:wait&#96; to wait for database\n- Check Docker containers: &#96;npm run docker:logs&#96;\n- Ensure Docker is running: &#96;docker ps&#96;\n- Restart: &#96;npm run docker:down &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up&#96;\n\n**Port already in use**:\n\n- Change port in &#96;package.json&#96;: &#96;\"dev\": \"next dev -p 3001\"&#96;\n\n**Auth not working**:\n\n- Ensure AUTH_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are set in .env\n- For email magic links, configure SMTP settings\n- For OAuth, add provider credentials\n\n**PWA icons missing**:",

        "contents": "# Pilot Program: First 10 Merchants\n\n**Referral Voucher + Merchant Credit** — proof, learning, testimonials.  \nNot scale.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Merchant Selection Checklist\n\nUse this **before** outreach. A prospect must satisfy ALL in Section A and at least one in Section B.  \nIf any Section A item is NO → skip.\n\n### Section A — Must have (all YES)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Local or regional business (not national/global) | | |\n| 2 | High trust, repeat customers (regulars) | | |\n| 3 | Easy-to-understand service or product | | |\n| 4 | Owner involved in daily operations | | |\n| 5 | Comfortable with WhatsApp, phone, or email | | |\n\n### Section B — Best fit (at least one)\n\n| # | Category | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Café or coffee shop | |\n| 2 | Salon or barbershop | |\n| 3 | Gym or studio | |\n| 4 | Tool rental or service business | |\n| 5 | Small retail with regulars | |\n\n### Section C — Exclude (any YES → skip)\n\n| # | Criterion | YES / NO |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| 1 | Big chain or franchise | |\n| 2 | Pure e‑commerce (no in‑person/regulars) | |\n| 3 | Discount‑driven / race‑to‑bottom positioning | |\n\n**Verdict:** _________________________________ (IN / OUT)  \n**Reason if OUT:** _________________________________\n\n---\n\n## 2. I can call or stop by.\n\n*If they ask “what is it?”:*  \n&gt; Your customers get a simple voucher to share. When someone uses it, you give the sharer a bit of store credit. Kõik ülesanded on lõpetatud.

## Lõpetatud ülesanded

1. **Playwright brauserid** — paigaldatud (Chromium, Firefox, WebKit)
2. **Security header'id** — lisatud `next.config.js` faili:
   - X-DNS-Prefetch-Control
   - Strict-Transport-Security
   - X-Frame-Options
   - X-Content-Type-Options
   - X-XSS-Protection
   - Referrer-Policy
   - Permissions-Policy

3. **E2E testide ID'd** — uuendatud:
   - Kasutavad `testVoucher` fixture'i, mis leiab voucher'e seed andmetest
   - Automaatselt loob voucher'e, kui need puuduvad

4. **E2E testide selector'id** — täiendatud:
   - Voucher lehel: `button` selector'id Share nupu jaoks
   - Referral lehel: `input#orderAmount` ja `button` selector'id redemption'ite jaoks
   - QR koodi kontroll: `img` selector'id

5. **Prisma migration** — dokumenteeritud:
   - Lisatud juhend, kuidas migreerida `db:push`'ist migration'itele
   - Migration süsteem on juba olemas (`launch_mode` migration)

## Muudetud failid

- `next.config.js` — lisatud security header'id
- `e2e/voucher-flow.spec.ts` — täiendatud selector'id ja testide loogika
- `docs/MIGRATIONS.md` — uuendatud migration juhend

## Järgmised sammud (käsitsi)

1. **Sentry seadistamine** (valikuline):
   - Loo Sentry konto
   - Lisa `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` environment variable

2. **Redis seadistamine** (tootmiseks):
   - Lisa `REDIS_URL` environment variable

3. **Cron job konfigureerimine**:
   - Seadista Vercel Cron või väline cron teenus
   - Kutsuda `/api/cron/credit-expiry-warnings` iga päev

4. **Migration'ite loomine** (kui vaja):
   - Kui soovid migreerida `db:push`'ist migration'itele, järgi `docs/MIGRATIONS.md` juhendit

Kõik koodipõhised ülesanded on valmis.

        "contents": "# Deployment Checklist\n\nUse this checklist before deploying to production.\n\n## Pre-Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables\n- [ ] &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; - Production PostgreSQL connection string\n- [ ] &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; - Random 32+ character string\n- [ ] &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL&#96; - Production URL (e.g., https://voucher.example.com)\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_HOST&#96; - Email server for magic links\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PORT&#96; - Email server port\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_USER&#96; - Email server username\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_PASSWORD&#96; - Email server password\n- [ ] &#96;SMTP_FROM&#96; - From email address\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_API_KEY&#96; - Resend API key (recommended for transactional emails)\n- [ ] &#96;RESEND_FROM_EMAIL&#96; - Default \"from\" address for Resend\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_SECRET_KEY&#96; - Stripe secret key (required for payments)\n- [ ] &#96;STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET&#96; - Stripe webhook signing secret (required for webhooks)\n- [ ] &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY&#96; - Stripe publishable key (client-side)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET&#96; - Google OAuth (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth client ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_SECRET&#96; - Apple OAuth secret (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_TEAM_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth team ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_KEY_ID&#96; - Apple OAuth key ID (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY&#96; - Apple OAuth private key (optional)\n- [ ] &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96; - Comma-separated admin emails\n- [ ] &#96;REDIS_URL&#96; - Redis connection (optional, for rate limiting)\n\n### Database\n- [ ] Production database created\n- [ ] Migration run: &#96;npx prisma migrate deploy&#96;\n- [ ] Prisma client generated: &#96;npx prisma generate&#96;\n- [ ] Seed data loaded (if needed)\n- [ ] Database backups configured\n\n### Security\n- [ ] All secrets in environment variables (not in code)\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] CORS configured correctly\n- [ ] Rate limiting configured\n- [ ] CSRF protection enabled (Next.js default)\n\n### PWA\n- [ ] &#96;manifest.json&#96; updated with production URL\n- [ ] Icons generated (192x192, 512x512)\n- [ ] Service worker tested\n- [ ] Offline functionality tested\n\n## Deployment Steps\n\n### 1. Build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run build\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Test Build Locally\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm start\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 3. Deploy\n- Deploy to your hosting platform (Vercel, Render, etc.)\n- Set all environment variables\n- Run database migrations\n\n### 4. Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works",

        "contents": "1. **Install Fly CLI**: &#96;curl -L https://fly.io/install.sh | sh&#96;\n2. **Login**: &#96;fly auth login&#96;\n3. **Launch**: &#96;fly launch&#96;\n4. **Set secrets**: &#96;fly secrets set KEY=value&#96;\n5. **Deploy**: &#96;fly deploy&#96;\n\n### Self-Hosted (Docker)\n\n1. **Build Docker image**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile\n   FROM node:18-alpine\n   WORKDIR /app\n   COPY package*.json ./\n   RUN npm ci --only=production\n   COPY . .\n   RUN npm run build\n   CMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Run with docker-compose**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n   services:\n     app:\n       build: .\n       ports:\n         - \"3000:3000\"\n       environment:\n         - DATABASE_URL=...\n         - NEXTAUTH_SECRET=...\n       depends_on:\n         - postgres\n         - redis\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Migrations\n\nIn production, use migrations instead of &#96;db:push&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm run db:migrate\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis creates a migration file that can be reviewed before applying.\n\n## Post-Deployment\n\n1. **Verify health**: Check &#96;/&#96; endpoint\n2. **Test authentication**: Try login flow\n3. **Test voucher creation**: Create a test voucher\n4. **Test redemption flow**: Complete end-to-end test\n5. **Monitor logs**: Check for errors\n6. **Set up monitoring**: Use Sentry, LogRocket, etc.\n\n## Scaling Considerations\n\n- **Database**: Use connection pooling (PgBouncer)\n- **Redis**: Use Redis Cluster for high availability\n- **CDN**: Use Vercel Edge Network or Cloudflare\n- **File Storage**: Use S3-compatible storage for brand assets\n- **Rate Limiting**: Configure Redis-based rate limiting\n- **Caching**: Cache public voucher pages\n\n## Security\n\n- [ ] HTTPS enabled\n- [ ] Environment variables secured (never commit to git)\n- [ ] Database credentials rotated regularly\n- [ ] OAuth redirect URIs configured correctly\n- [ ] CORS configured (if needed)\n- [ ] Rate limiting enabled\n- [ ] Audit logging enabled\n\n## Backup Strategy\n\n1. **Database backups**: Daily automated backups\n2. **File backups**: S3 versioning enabled\n3. **Configuration backups**: Store env vars securely\n4. **Test restore**: Regularly test backup restoration\n\n## Monitoring",

          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;dockerfile",
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "   FROM node:18-alpine",

          },
          {
            "text": "   WORKDIR /app",

          },
          {
            "text": "   COPY package*.json ./",

          },
          {
            "text": "   RUN npm ci --only=production",
            "lineNumber": 97
          },
          {
            "text": "   COPY . .",
            "lineNumber": 98
          },
          {
            "text": "   RUN npm run build",
            "lineNumber": 99
          },
          {
            "text": "   CMD [\"npm\", \"start\"]",

          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 101
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 102
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Run with docker-compose**:",
            "lineNumber": 103
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 104
          },
          {
            "text": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml",
            "lineNumber": 105
          },
          {
            "text": "   services:",

          },
          {
            "text": "     app:",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },

          },
          {
            "text": "       environment:",

          },
          {
            "text": "         - DATABASE_URL=...",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 113
          },
          {

          },

            "text": "         - postgres",

          },
          {

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 117
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 118
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Migrations",
            "lineNumber": 119
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 120
          },
          {
            "text": "In production, use migrations instead of &#96;db:push&#96;:",
            "lineNumber": 121
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 122
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;bash",
            "lineNumber": 123
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run db:migrate",
            "lineNumber": 124
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 125
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 126
          },
          {
            "text": "This creates a migration file that can be reviewed before applying.",
            "lineNumber": 127
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 128
          },
          {
            "text": "## Post-Deployment",
            "lineNumber": 129
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Verify health**: Check &#96;/&#96; endpoint",
            "lineNumber": 131
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Test authentication**: Try login flow",
            "lineNumber": 132
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Test voucher creation**: Create a test voucher",
            "lineNumber": 133
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Test redemption flow**: Complete end-to-end test",
            "lineNumber": 134
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Monitor logs**: Check for errors",
            "lineNumber": 135
          },
          {
            "text": "6. **Set up monitoring**: Use Sentry, LogRocket, etc.",
            "lineNumber": 136
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 137
          },
          {
            "text": "## Scaling Considerations",
            "lineNumber": 138
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 139
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Database**: Use connection pooling (PgBouncer)",
            "lineNumber": 140
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Redis**: Use Redis Cluster for high availability",
            "lineNumber": 141
          },
          {
            "text": "- **CDN**: Use Vercel Edge Network or Cloudflare",
            "lineNumber": 142
          },
          {
            "text": "- **File Storage**: Use S3-compatible storage for brand assets",
            "lineNumber": 143
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Rate Limiting**: Configure Redis-based rate limiting",
            "lineNumber": 144
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Caching**: Cache public voucher pages",
            "lineNumber": 145
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 146
          },
          {
            "text": "## Security",
            "lineNumber": 147
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 148
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] HTTPS enabled",
            "lineNumber": 149
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Environment variables secured (never commit to git)",
            "lineNumber": 150
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Database credentials rotated regularly",
            "lineNumber": 151
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] OAuth redirect URIs configured correctly",
            "lineNumber": 152
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] CORS configured (if needed)",
            "lineNumber": 153
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Rate limiting enabled",
            "lineNumber": 154
          },
          {
            "text": "- [ ] Audit logging enabled",
            "lineNumber": 155
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 156
          },
          {
            "text": "## Backup Strategy",
            "lineNumber": 157
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 158
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Database backups**: Daily automated backups",
            "lineNumber": 159
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **File backups**: S3 versioning enabled",
            "lineNumber": 160
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Configuration backups**: Store env vars securely",
            "lineNumber": 161
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Test restore**: Regularly test backup restoration",
            "lineNumber": 162
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 163
          },
          {

          }

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:\n\n   - &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;: PostgreSQL connection string\n   - &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - &#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - OAuth providers (optional for local dev)\n   - SMTP settings (for email magic links)\n\n1. Start Docker services and set up database:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended - checks Docker, starts containers, waits for DB, pushes schema, seeds)\n   npm run db:setup\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Or manually:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Check Docker Desktop is running\n   npm run db:check\n\n   # Start Docker containers\n   npm run docker:up\n\n   # Wait for database to be ready\n   npm run db:wait\n\n   # Push database schema\n   npm run db:push\n\n   # Seed database\n   npm run db:seed\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   **Troubleshooting**: If you encounter Docker issues, see [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)\n\n1. Start the development server:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nOpen [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000) in your browser.\n\n## Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;text\n├── app/                    # Next.js App Router pages\n│   ├── api/               # API route handlers\n│   ├── app/               # User app pages\n│   ├── merchant/          # Merchant dashboard\n│   ├── m/                 # Public merchant pages\n│   ├── v/                 # Public voucher pages\n│   └── r/                 # Public referral pages\n├── components/            # React components\n│   └── ui/               # shadcn/ui components\n├── lib/                   # Utility libraries\n│   ├── auth.ts           # NextAuth configuration\n│   ├── rbac.ts           # Role-based access control\n│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention",

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

        "contents": "# Vouchr\n\nMerchant-owned referral infrastructure: branded vouchers and store credit. Pay for results, not reach. Production-ready, global, multi-tenant; Web and PWA.\n\n**Status**: ✅ MVP Complete - Ready for launch mode testing\n\nSee [MVP_COMPLIANCE.md](docs/MVP_COMPLIANCE.md) for full compliance report.\n\n## Quick Links\n\n- [Testing Guide](docs/TESTING_GUIDE.md) - Test all 8 MVP flows\n- [Launch Mode Guide](docs/LAUNCH_MODE_IMPLEMENTATION.md) - Kill switch &amp; feature flags\n- [Deployment Checklist](docs/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST.md) - Pre-production checklist\n- [V2 Backlog](docs/V2_BACKLOG.md) - Future features (documented only)\n\n## Features\n\n- **Multi-tenant Architecture**: Each merchant is a tenant with isolated data\n- **Voucher Management**: Create, publish, and manage vouchers with custom designs\n- **Campaign Management**: Create campaigns with pricing, limits, and referral credit percentages\n- **Event Management**: Create events with tickets, capacity management, and ticket types\n- **Referral System**: Users share vouchers; referrers earn merchant-specific credit\n- **Credit System**: Non-transferable, per-merchant credits that expire\n- **Weekly Drops**: Limited-time voucher drops with stock management\n- **PWA Support**: Installable web app with offline QR code generation\n- **RBAC**: Role-based access control (platform_admin, merchant_admin, merchant_staff, user)\n- **Fraud Prevention**: Rate limiting, self-referral prevention, risk signals\n- **Stripe Integration**: Payment processing for voucher and ticket purchases\n\n## Tech Stack\n\n- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui\n- **Backend**: Next.js Route Handlers, NextAuth\n- **Database**: PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM\n- **Cache**: Redis (optional for local dev)\n- **Auth**: Email magic link, Google OAuth, Apple OAuth\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+\n- Docker and Docker Compose (for local database)\n- PostgreSQL 16+ (if not using Docker)\n\n### Installation\n\n1. Clone the repository:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   git clone &lt;repository-url&gt;\n   cd voucher\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Install dependencies:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:",

        "contents": "# Quick Start Guide\n\n## Ühe käsuga (soovitus) — &#96;dev:full&#96;\n\nKui Docker Desktop on käivitatud:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee käivitab: Postgres, loob/värskendab &#96;.env.local&#96;, teeb &#96;db push&#96;, &#96;db:seed&#96; ja &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;, siis dev-serveri.\n\n**Testikasutaja:** &#96;test@example.com&#96; / &#96;test123&#96;  \n**Lehed:** &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → /app (Coffee House: Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard)\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ installed\n- Docker Desktop installed and running\n- Git (optional)\n\n## Setup Steps\n\n1. **Install dependencies**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set up environment**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Copy the example env file\n   # Edit .env and set:\n   # - AUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - NEXTAUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - DATABASE_URL (already set for Docker)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Start database and initialize**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended)\n   npm run db:setup\n   \n   # Or manually:\n   npm run db:check      # Check Docker Desktop\n   npm run docker:up     # Start containers\n   npm run db:wait       # Wait for database\n   npm run db:push       # Push schema\n   npm run db:seed       # Seed data\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Start development server**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Open browser**:\n   Navigate to &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt;\n\n## Test the Flow\n\n1. **View a voucher** (after creating one):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&gt;\n   - Replace [voucherId] with an actual voucher ID from your database\n   - Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Login** (e‑post + parool):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt;\n   - [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) / **test123** (Credentials; töötab kohe kui &#96;dev:full&#96; või &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; on käivitatud)\n   - Või [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com) — magic link (vajab SMTP) või OAuth\n\n3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;",

        "contents": "# Full dev startup: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed/ensure-test-user, dev server\n# Run: npm run dev:full\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"..\")).Path\nSet-Location $root\n\ndocker info 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] Docker ei käivitu. Käivita Docker Desktop ja proovi: npm run dev:full\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n$localUrl = \"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db\"\n$authSecret = \"voucher-dev-secret-min-32-chars-long\"\n$envLocalPath = Join-Path $root \".env.local\"\n\n# 1) .env.local (local Postgres + AUTH_SECRET, et Next.js ja auth töötaks)\n@\"\n# Local Docker Postgres (dev:full)\nDATABASE_URL=\"$localUrl\"\nAUTH_SECRET=\"$authSecret\"\n\"@ | Set-Content -Path $envLocalPath -Encoding utf8 -Force\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] .env.local ok\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 2) Docker Postgres\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting Postgres...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\ndocker compose up -d postgres 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Waiting for DB...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; \"$PSScriptRoot\\wait-for-db.ps1\" -MaxAttempts 30 -DelaySeconds 2\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] DB not ready. Check: docker compose logs postgres\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n# 3) Prisma + seed (DATABASE_URL for Prisma CLI)\n$env:DATABASE_URL = $localUrl\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] prisma db push...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpx prisma db push\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:seed (may fail if data exists)...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:seed 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:ensure-test-user...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:ensure-test-user\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] ensure-test-user ebaõnnestus\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Test: test@example.com / test123\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting dev server...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpm run dev",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.\n- **wait-for-db.ps1:** TcpClient to &#96;127.0.0.1:5432&#96;.\n- **dev:full:** &#96;docker compose up -d postgres&#96;, then wait-for-db, db push, seed, ensure-test-user.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Seed ✅\n\n- Merchants: Coffee House, Tech Store.\n- Users: [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com), [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (upsert).\n- [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is member of Coffee House (merchant_admin).\n- Vouchers, referral, redemption, credit, audit log.\n\n---\n\n## 7. Known / Non-blocking\n\n- **next-intl:** &#96;getRequestConfig&#96; &#96;locale&#96; is deprecated in favor of &#96;requestLocale&#96;; non-blocking.\n- **i18n:** &#96;getRequestConfig&#96; must return &#96;locale&#96;; next major may require it.\n\n---\n\n## 8.         "contents": "# Troubleshooting Guide\n\n## Docker Desktop Issues\n\n### Problem: \"Docker Desktop is unable to start\"\n\n**Solution 1: Start Docker Desktop manually**\n1. Open Docker Desktop from Start Menu\n2. Wait for it to fully start (whale icon in system tray)\n3. Run &#96;npm run docker:up&#96; again\n\n**Solution 2: Restart Docker Desktop**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Stop Docker Desktop\nStop-Process -Name \"Docker Desktop\" -Force\n\n# Start Docker Desktop\nStart-Process \"${env:ProgramFiles}\\Docker\\Docker\\Docker Desktop.exe\"\n\n# Wait 30-60 seconds, then check\ndocker info\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Solution 3: Check WSL2 (Windows)**\nDocker Desktop requires WSL2 on Windows:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Check WSL version\nwsl --list --verbose\n\n# If WSL2 is not installed, install it:\nwsl --install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Solution 4: Restart Windows**\nSometimes Docker Desktop needs a system restart to work properly.\n\n### Problem: \"Can't reach database server at &#96;localhost:5432&#96;\"\n\n**Check if Docker containers are running:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\ndocker ps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**If containers are not running:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Start containers\nnpm run docker:up\n\n# Or manually\ndocker compose up -d\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Check container logs:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\nnpm run docker:logs\n\n# Or manually\ndocker compose logs postgres\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n**Verify database connection:**\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Wait for database to be ready\nnpm run db:wait\n\n# Or check manually\nTest-NetConnection -ComputerName localhost -Port 5432\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Setup\n\n### Quick Setup (Recommended)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# This will:\n# 1. Check Docker Desktop\n# 2. Start containers\n# 3. Wait for database\n# 4. Push schema\n# 5. Seed data\nnpm run db:setup\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Manual Setup\n&#96;&#96;&#96;powershell\n# Step 1: Check Docker\nnpm run db:check\n\n# Step 2: Start containers\nnpm run docker:up\n\n# Step 3: Wait for database\nnpm run db:wait\n\n# Step 4: Push schema\nnpm run db:push\n\n# Step 5: Seed data\nnpm run db:seed\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Environment Variables\n\nMake sure &#96;.env&#96; file exists with:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nDATABASE_URL=\"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db?schema=public\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Common Issues\n\n### Port 5432 already in use",

        "contents": "// This is your Prisma schema file,\n// learn more about it in the docs: https://pris.ly/d/prisma-schema\n\ngenerator client {\n  provider = \"prisma-client-js\"\n}\n\ndatasource db {\n  provider = \"postgresql\"\n  url      = env(\"DATABASE_URL\")\n}\n\nmodel Account {\n  id                String  @id @default(cuid())\n  userId            String\n  type              String\n  provider          String\n  providerAccountId String\n  refresh_token     String? @db.Text\n  access_token      String? @db.Text\n  expires_at        Int?\n  token_type        String?\n  scope             String?\n  id_token          String? @db.Text\n  session_state     String?\n\n  user User @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@unique([provider, providerAccountId])\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel Session {\n  id           String   @id @default(cuid())\n  sessionToken String   @unique\n  userId       String\n  expires      DateTime\n  user         User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)\n\n  @@index([userId])\n}\n\nmodel VerificationToken {\n  identifier String\n  token      String   @unique\n  expires    DateTime\n\n  @@unique([identifier, token])\n}\n\nmodel User {\n  id            String    @id @default(cuid())\n  email         String    @unique\n  emailVerified DateTime?\n  name          String?\n  image         String?\n  createdAt     DateTime  @default(now())\n  updatedAt     DateTime  @updatedAt\n\n  accounts         Account[]\n  sessions         Session[]\n  merchantMembers  MerchantMember[]\n  referrals        Referral[]         @relation(\"Referrer\")\n  redemptions      Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedBy\")\n  staffRedemptions Redemption[]        @relation(\"RedeemedByStaff\")\n  creditLedgers    CreditLedger[]\n  creditUsages     CreditUsage[]\n  voucherPurchases VoucherPurchase[]\n  ticketPurchases  TicketPurchase[]\n  auditLogs        AuditLog[]\n}\n\nmodel Merchant {\n  ",

Post-Deployment\n\n#### Verify\n- [ ] Homepage loads\n- [ ] Login works\n- [ ] Magic link emails sent\n- [ ] OAuth providers work (if configured)\n- [ ] Voucher pages load\n- [ ] Referral pages load\n- [ ] PWA installable\n- [ ] Service worker active\n\n#### Test Core Flows\n- [ ] Create voucher\n- [ ] Create campaign\n- [ ] Generate vouchers from campaign\n- [ ] Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- [ ] Publish voucher\n- [ ] Share referral\n- [ ] Redeem voucher\n- [ ] Confirm redemption\n- [ ] Credit unlocks\n- [ ] Apply credit\n- [ ] Create event\n- [ ] Generate tickets for event\n- [ ] Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n#### Monitor\n- [ ] Error logs checked\n- [ ] Performance metrics reviewed\n- [ ] Database connections stable\n- [ ] API response times acceptable\n\n## Launch Mode Setup\n\n### Initial Setup\n- [ ] Run launch mode migration\n- [ ] Create first merchant via database\n- [ ] Add merchant admin user\n- [ ] Test merchant dashboard access\n- [ ] Verify kill switch works\n\n### Merchant Onboarding\n- [ ] Document onboarding process\n- [ ] Create merchant invite template\n- [ ] Set up merchant creation workflow\n- [ ] Test feature flags\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Set Up\n- [ ] Error tracking (Sentry, etc.)\n- [ ] Performance monitoring\n- [ ] Database monitoring\n- [ ] Uptime monitoring\n- [ ] Log aggregation\n\n### Alerts\n- [ ] Database connection failures\n- [ ] High error rates\n- [ ] Slow API responses\n- [ ] Merchant deactivations\n- [ ] Unusual redemption patterns\n\n## Rollback Plan\n\n### If Issues Occur\n1. **Immediate**: Deactivate problematic merchants via kill switch\n2. **Short-term**: Revert deployment if critical bug\n3. **Long-term**: Fix issue and redeploy\n\n### Rollback Steps\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# 1. Revert code deployment\n# 2. Check database migrations (may need to rollback)\n# 3. Verify environment variables\n# 4.         "contents": "3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;\n   - Fill in the form and create a voucher\n\n4. **Share voucher**:\n   - View the voucher at &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96; to check Docker status\n- Start Docker Desktop manually from Start Menu\n- See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md][troubleshooting] for detailed solutions\n\n**Database connection error**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:wait&#96; to wait for database\n- Check Docker containers: &#96;npm run docker:logs&#96;\n- Ensure Docker is running: &#96;docker ps&#96;\n- Restart: &#96;npm run docker:down &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up&#96;\n\n**Port already in use**:\n\n- Change port in &#96;package.json&#96;: &#96;\"dev\": \"next dev -p 3001\"&#96;\n\n**Auth not working**:\n\n- Ensure AUTH_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are set in .env\n- For email magic links, configure SMTP settings\n- For OAuth, add provider credentials\n\n**PWA icons missing**:",

        "contents": "{\n  \"name\": \"voucher-platform\",\n  \"version\": \"1.0.0\",\n  \"private\": true,\n  \"scripts\": {\n    \"dev\": \"next dev\",\n    \"dev:clean\": \"node -e \\\"require('fs').rmSync('.next',{recursive:true,force:true})\\\" &amp;&amp; next dev\",\n    \"dev:all\": \"npm run dev:full\",\n    \"dev:full\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/dev-full.ps1\",\n    \"build\": \"node scripts/build.cjs\",\n    \"build:next\": \"next build\",\n    \"start\": \"next start\",\n    \"lint\": \"next lint\",\n    \"docker:up\": \"docker compose up -d\",\n    \"docker:down\": \"docker compose down\",\n    \"docker:logs\": \"docker compose logs -f\",\n    \"db:check\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/check-docker.ps1\",\n    \"db:wait\": \"powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/wait-for-db.ps1\",\n    \"db:setup\": \"npm run db:check &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up &amp;&amp; timeout /t 5 /nobreak &gt;nul 2&gt;&amp;1 || node -e \\\"const d=Date.now(); while(Date.now()-d&lt;5000);\\\" &amp;&amp; npm run db:wait &amp;&amp; npm run db:push &amp;&amp; npm run db:seed\",\n    \"db:push\": \"prisma db push\",\n    \"db:migrate\": \"prisma migrate dev\",\n    \"db:seed\": \"tsx prisma/seed.ts\",\n    \"db:ensure-test-user\": \"tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts\",\n    \"db:studio\": \"prisma studio\",\n    \"test\": \"vitest\",\n    \"test:ui\": \"vitest --ui\",\n    \"test:e2e\": \"playwright test\",\n    \"test:e2e:ui\": \"playwright test --ui\",",

        "contents": "DATABASE_URL=\"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db?schema=public\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Common Issues\n\n### Port 5432 already in use\nIf PostgreSQL is already running on port 5432:\n1. Check Docker Desktop logs: &#96;docker compose logs&#96;\n2. Check Prisma logs: &#96;npm run db:push&#96; (verbose output)\n3. Verify &#96;.env&#96; file has correct &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;\n4.       "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": ".\\README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 125
          },
          "endPosition": {

          }

        "contents": "│   ├── tenant.ts         # Multi-tenant utilities\n│   ├── fraud.ts          # Fraud prevention\n│   └── credits.ts        # Credit management\n├── prisma/               # Prisma schema and migrations\n│   ├── schema.prisma     # Database schema\n│   └── seed.ts           # Seed script\n└── public/               # Static assets\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Core Flows\n\n### 1. Merchant Creates Voucher\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new&#96;\n2. Fill in voucher details (type, value, validity, limits)\n3. Configure weekly drop (optional)\n4. Design voucher (colors, headline, fine print)\n5. Publish voucher\n\n### 2. User Shares Voucher\n\n1. User opens voucher landing page (&#96;/v/[id]&#96;)\n2. Clicks \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"\n3. System creates referral and generates share URL\n4. User shares link via native share sheet or copy\n\n### 3. Friend Redeems Voucher\n\n1. Friend opens referral link (&#96;/r/[id]&#96;)\n2. Sees branded voucher with QR code\n3. Redeems online or in-store\n4. System creates redemption (unconfirmed for in-store)\n5. Locked credit created for referrer\n\n### 4. Staff Confirms Redemption\n\n1. Staff views redemptions at &#96;/merchant/[slug]/redemptions&#96;\n2. Confirms in-store redemption\n3. Credit unlocks for referrer\n\n### 5. Referrer Uses Credit\n\n1. View wallet at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/wallet&#96;\n2. Go to checkout demo at &#96;/app/[merchantSlug]/checkout-demo&#96;\n3. Apply credit to order\n\n## API Endpoints\n\nSee [API Documentation](./docs/API.md) for complete API reference.\n\n### Merchant Vouchers\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - Create voucher\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers&#96; - List vouchers\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Get voucher\n- &#96;PUT /api/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/[id]&#96; - Update voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish voucher\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase voucher (Stripe checkout)\n- &#96;POST /api/vouchers/[id]/grant&#96; - Grant free voucher\n\n### Campaigns\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - Create campaign\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/campaigns&#96; - List campaigns\n- &#96;GET /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Get campaign\n- &#96;PUT /api/campaigns/[id]&#96; - Update campaign\n- &#96;POST /api/campaigns/[id]/generate-vouchers&#96; - Generate vouchers from campaign\n\n### Events\n\n- &#96;POST /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - Create event\n- &#96;GET /api/merchant/[slug]/events&#96; - List events\n- &#96;GET /api/events/[id]&#96; - Get event\n- &#96;PUT /api/events/[id]&#96; - Update event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [

        "range": {

          "endPosition": {
