        },
        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",

        "contents": "# PowerShell script to wait for database to be ready\nparam(\n    [int]$MaxAttempts = 60,\n    [int]$DelaySeconds = 2\n)\n\nWrite-Host \"Waiting for PostgreSQL database to be ready...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n\n$attempt = 0\nwhile ($attempt -lt $MaxAttempts) {\n    $attempt++\n    \n    try {\n        $tcp = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient\n        $tcp.Connect(\"127.0.0.1\", 5432)\n        $tcp.Close()\n        Write-Host \"✅ Database is ready!\" -ForegroundColor Green\n        Start-Sleep -Seconds 2\n        exit 0\n    } catch {\n        # Connection failed, continue\n    }\n    \n    if ($attempt -lt $MaxAttempts) {\n        $remaining = $MaxAttempts - $attempt\n        if ($attempt % 5 -eq 0) {\n            Write-Host \"  Still waiting... (${remaining} attempts remaining)\" -ForegroundColor Gray\n        }\n        Start-Sleep -Seconds $DelaySeconds\n    }\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"❌ Database is not ready after $MaxAttempts attempts\" -ForegroundColor Red\nWrite-Host \"Please check:\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  1. Docker Desktop is running\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  2. Containers are up: docker ps\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nWrite-Host \"  3. Check logs: docker compose logs postgres\" -ForegroundColor Yellow\nexit 1",

        "contents": "---\nname: voucher\ndescription: This is a new rule\n---\n\n# Voucher Rules\n\n## 0) SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH\n\nAinus tõde on TOTAL / ALL-IN PROMPT + MVP UI Scope-lock + Business Rules.\n\nKui miski on vastuolus → ära ehita.\n\nKüsimuse korral → küsi enne.\n\n## 1) MVP SCOPE ON LUKUS\n\nEHITADA TOHIB AINULT:\n\nVoucher → Referral → Redemption → Credit → Wallet\n\nPublic pages ilma login’ita\n\nMerchant dashboard minimaalses mahus\n\nKEELATUD MVP-S:\n\nmarketplace\n\nfeed\n\nkommentaarid / like’id\n\nloyalty tiers / badges\n\nads\n\nAI\n\ngrowth-hackid\n\nextra analytics\n\nKui funktsioon ei aita jagada, lunastada või krediteerida, siis ära ehita.\n\n## 2) TECH STACK ON LUKUS\n\nNext.js (App Router)\n\nTypeScript kõikjal\n\nPrisma + PostgreSQL\n\nshadcn/ui + Tailwind\n\nPWA (manifest + service worker)\n\nnext-intl (EN default)\n\nEi mingeid:\n\nteisi frameworke\n\ncustom CSS süsteeme\n\nteisi ORM-e\n\nparoolipõhist auth’i\n\n## 3) ROLLID &amp; ÕIGUSED (RANGE)\n\nanonymous → ainult public pages\n\nuser → ainult enda wallet &amp; vouchers\n\nmerchant_staff → redemption confirm\n\nmerchant_admin → voucherid, settings\n\nplatform_admin → audit &amp; risk\n\nReegel:\nUI võib peita, server peab alati kontrollima.\n\n## 4) PUBLIC PAGES REEGEL (KRIITILINE)\n\n/v/[voucherId] ja /r/[referralId]:\n\nEI TOHI nõuda login’it\n\nPEAVAD avanema &lt;1s\n\nPEAVAD töötama mobiilis ideaalselt\n\nJagamine peab olema 1 tap.\n\n## 5) BUSINESS RULES (MITTEVAIDLUSTATAV)\n\nCredit ≠ raha\n\nCredit on merchant-põhine\n\nCredit:\n\nalgul locked\n\navailable ainult pärast redemption confirm\n\naegub\n\nSelf-referral on keelatud\n\nWeekly Drop:\n\nlimited stock\n\nfirst-come-first-served\n\nkui otsas → otsas\n\n## 6) DATA &amp; TRANSACTIONS\n\nKõik write’id:\n\ntransaction’iga\n\nserver-side validatsioon\n\nÄra salvesta:\n\nraw phone/email (hash ainult)\n\nPrisma schema = püha\n\nÄra kasuta JSON-i, kui on vaja relatsiooni (v.a designJson, conditionsJson).\n\n## 7) UI &amp; UX REEGLID\n\n1 primary CTA per vaade\n\nMobile-first (desktop = enhancement)\n\nEi mingeid “wizard’eid” üle 2 sammu\n\nEi mingeid modal-hell’e\n\nCredit peab tunduma päris väärtusena",

Kõik järgmised sammud on tehtud või dokumenteeritud.

## Lõpetatud ülesanded

1. **E2E testi parandus** — parandatud `isAuthenticated` muutuja viga
2. **DEPLOYMENT.md täiendamine** — lisatud:
   - Sentry seadistamise juhend
   - Redis seadistamise juhend
   - Cron job'ide seadistamise juhend (Vercel Cron ja väline teenus)
3. **Vercel Cron konfiguratsioon** — loodud `vercel.json` fail credit expiry warnings cron job'ile
4. **COMPLETION_REPORT.md uuendamine** — märgitud tehtud sammud

## Loodud/muudetud failid

- `vercel.json` — Vercel Cron konfiguratsioon
- `e2e/voucher-flow.spec.ts` — parandatud testi viga
- `DEPLOYMENT.md` — täiendatud Sentry, Redis ja cron job'ide juhenditega
- `docs/COMPLETION_REPORT.md` — uuendatud tehtud sammudega

## Järgmised sammud (käsitsi konfigureerimine)

1. **Sentry**:
   - Loo konto https://sentry.io
   - Lisa `NEXT_PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN` environment variable
   - Vaata `DEPLOYMENT.md` juhendit

2. **Redis**:
   - Vali provider (Upstash, Render, jne)
   - Lisa `REDIS_URL` environment variable
   - Vaata `DEPLOYMENT.md` juhendit

3. **Cron job**:
   - Kui kasutad Vercel'it, `vercel.json` on juba valmis
   - Lisa `CRON_SECRET` environment variable
   - Või kasuta välist cron teenust (vaata `DEPLOYMENT.md`)

Kõik koodipõhised ülesanded on valmis. Projekt on valmis tootmiseks, kui on konfigureeritud välisteenused (Sentry, Redis, cron job'id).

        "contents": "3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;\n   - Fill in the form and create a voucher\n\n4. **Share voucher**:\n   - View the voucher at &#96;/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" (requires login)\n   - Copy the referral link\n\n5. **Redeem voucher**:\n   - Open referral link in incognito/private window\n   - Enter order amount and click \"Redeem Online\"\n\n6. **Confirm redemption** (as staff):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&gt;\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" on pending redemptions\n\n7. **View credit wallet**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&gt;\n   - See unlocked credit\n\n8. **Apply credit**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/checkout-demo&gt;\n   - Enter order amount and apply credit\n\n## Seed Data\n\nThe seed script creates:\n\n- 2 merchants (Coffee House, Tech Store)\n- 3 users: [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) (parool: test123), [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com), [user@example.com](mailto:user@example.com)\n- Sample vouchers, referrals, and credits\n\n&#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96; tagab [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) ja Coffee House liikmelisuse ka siis, kui seed on juba käivitatud.\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n**Docker Desktop not starting**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:check&#96; to check Docker status\n- Start Docker Desktop manually from Start Menu\n- See [TROUBLESHOOTING.md][troubleshooting] for detailed solutions\n\n**Database connection error**:\n\n- Run: &#96;npm run db:wait&#96; to wait for database\n- Check Docker containers: &#96;npm run docker:logs&#96;\n- Ensure Docker is running: &#96;docker ps&#96;\n- Restart: &#96;npm run docker:down &amp;&amp; npm run docker:up&#96;\n\n**Port already in use**:\n\n- Change port in &#96;package.json&#96;: &#96;\"dev\": \"next dev -p 3001\"&#96;\n\n**Auth not working**:\n\n- Ensure AUTH_SECRET and NEXTAUTH_SECRET are set in .env\n- For email magic links, configure SMTP settings\n- For OAuth, add provider credentials\n\n**PWA icons missing**:",

        "contents": "# Vouchr — Full Audit\n\n**Date:** 2025-01  \n**Scope:** Get project running; deps, scripts, auth, env, routes.\n\n---\n\n## 1. Package &amp; Scripts ✅\n\n| Script | Action |\n| --- | --- |\n| &#96;dev&#96; | next dev |\n| &#96;dev:full&#96; | scripts/dev-full.ps1: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed, ensure-test-user, dev |\n| &#96;db:setup&#96; | db:check, docker:up, wait 5s, db:wait, db:push, db:seed (no ensure-test-user) |\n| &#96;db:seed&#96; | tsx prisma/seed.ts |\n| &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; | tsx prisma/ensure-test-user.ts ([test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) + Coffee House) |\n| &#96;db:push&#96; | prisma db push |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; is the one-command path; requires Docker Desktop.\n- &#96;db:setup&#96; does not run &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;; seed already upserts &#96;test@example.com&#96; and member.\n- **Seed on existing DB:** &#96;merchant.create&#96; etc. can fail with \"Unique constraint\" (e.g. &#96;slug&#96;). Run &#96;npm run db:ensure-test-user&#96;; test user and Coffee House are then ensured.\n\n---\n\n## 2. Auth ✅\n\n- **Credentials:** [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) / test123 (dev; from &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96;, &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; or defaults).\n- **Email:** magic link (needs SMTP in .env).\n- **OAuth:** Google, Apple (optional env).\n- **Session:** &#96;strategy: 'jwt'&#96; (required for Credentials).\n\n---\n\n## 3. Env\n\n| Var | Required | Notes |\n| --- | --- | --- |\n| &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; | yes | Local: &#96;postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db&#96; |\n| &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96; | yes | min 32 chars |\n| &#96;NEXTAUTH_URL&#96; | optional | e.g. &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt; |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_EMAIL&#96; | no | default [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) (dev) |\n| &#96;TEST_USER_PASSWORD&#96; | no | default test123 (dev) |\n\n- &#96;dev:full&#96; overwrites &#96;.env.local&#96; with &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;.\n- &#96;.env&#96; is used when &#96;.env.local&#96; is absent; ensure only one &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96; (local Postgres).\n\n---\n\n## 4. Login &amp; /app ✅\n\n- **/login:** Credentials (e‑post+parool), magic link, Google, Apple. Test hint shown in dev.\n- **/app:** After login, lists user’s merchants (Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard). [test@example.com](mailto:test@example.com) is &#96;merchant_admin&#96; for Coffee House (seed + ensure-test-user).\n\n---\n\n## 5. Docker &amp; DB ✅\n\n- **docker-compose.yml:** postgres (voucher_user, voucher_pass, voucher_db, 5432), redis.",

        "contents": "const prisma = new PrismaClient();\n\nasync function main() {\n  const merchant = await prisma.merchant.upsert({\n    where: { slug: 'coffee-house' },\n    create: {\n      name: 'Coffee House',\n      slug: 'coffee-house',\n      country: 'US',\n      defaultCurrency: 'USD',\n    },\n    update: {},\n  });\n\n  const testUser = await prisma.user.upsert({\n    where: { email: 'test@example.com' },\n    create: { email: 'test@example.com', name: 'Test User', emailVerified: new Date() },\n    update: {},\n  });\n\n  await prisma.merchantMember.upsert({\n    where: { merchantId_userId: { merchantId: merchant.id, userId: testUser.id } },\n    create: { merchantId: merchant.id, userId: testUser.id, role: 'merchant_admin' },\n    update: {},\n  });\n\n  console.log('✅ Test user ok: test@example.com / test123 → merchant', merchant.slug);\n}\n\nmain()\n  .catch((e) =&gt; {\n    console.error('❌ ensure-test-user failed:', e);\n  }",

        "contents": "# Quick Start Guide\n\n## Ühe käsuga (soovitus) — &#96;dev:full&#96;\n\nKui Docker Desktop on käivitatud:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install\nnpm run dev:full\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nSee käivitab: Postgres, loob/värskendab &#96;.env.local&#96;, teeb &#96;db push&#96;, &#96;db:seed&#96; ja &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96;, siis dev-serveri.\n\n**Testikasutaja:** &#96;test@example.com&#96; / &#96;test123&#96;  \n**Lehed:** &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt; → /app (Coffee House: Wallet, Vouchers, Merchant Dashboard)\n\n---\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ installed\n- Docker Desktop installed and running\n- Git (optional)\n\n## Setup Steps\n\n1. **Install dependencies**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n2. **Set up environment**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Copy the example env file\n   # Edit .env and set:\n   # - AUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - NEXTAUTH_SECRET (generate: openssl rand -base64 32)\n   # - DATABASE_URL (already set for Docker)\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n3. **Start database and initialize**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended)\n   npm run db:setup\n   \n   # Or manually:\n   npm run db:check      # Check Docker Desktop\n   npm run docker:up     # Start containers\n   npm run db:wait       # Wait for database\n   npm run db:push       # Push schema\n   npm run db:seed       # Seed data\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. **Start development server**:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm run dev\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n5. **Open browser**:\n   Navigate to &lt;http://localhost:3000&gt;\n\n## Test the Flow\n\n1. **View a voucher** (after creating one):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&gt;\n   - Replace [voucherId] with an actual voucher ID from your database\n   - Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Login** (e‑post + parool):\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/login&gt;\n   - [**test@example.com**](mailto:test@example.com) / **test123** (Credentials; töötab kohe kui &#96;dev:full&#96; või &#96;db:ensure-test-user&#96; on käivitatud)\n   - Või [admin@coffee-house.com](mailto:admin@coffee-house.com) — magic link (vajab SMTP) või OAuth\n\n3. **Create a voucher**:\n   - Go to &lt;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/vouchers/new&gt;",

        "contents": "# Testing Guide - MVP Done Definition\n\nThis guide walks through all 8 steps of the MVP \"done definition\" to verify the platform works end-to-end.\n\n## Prerequisites\n\n1. Database is seeded: &#96;npm run db:seed&#96;\n2. Development server is running: &#96;npm run dev&#96;\n3. You have two browser windows/tabs (one for referrer, one for friend)\n\n## Test Data\n\nAfter seeding, you should have:\n- **Merchant**: Coffee House (slug: &#96;coffee-house&#96;)\n- **Admin user**: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n- **Regular user**: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n- **Vouchers**: At least one published voucher\n\n## Step-by-Step Test Flow\n\n### Step 1: Open Voucher Page ✅\n\n1. **Find a voucher ID** from the database:\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n   SELECT id, \"codePrefix\" FROM \"Voucher\" WHERE status = 'published' LIMIT 1;\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n   Or check Prisma Studio: &#96;npm run db:studio&#96;\n\n2. **Open voucher page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/v/[voucherId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show merchant branding\n   - Should display voucher value clearly\n   - Should have \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\" button (if logged in)\n\n**Expected**: Voucher page loads in &lt;3 seconds, shows value, merchant brand visible.\n\n---\n\n### Step 2: Create Referral ✅\n\n1. **Login as user**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link (or use OAuth if configured)\n\n2. **Open voucher page** (from Step 1)\n\n3. **Click \"Share &amp; Earn Credit\"**:\n   - Should create referral via &#96;/api/referrals/create&#96;\n   - Should generate share URL: &#96;/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should show native share sheet or copy link\n\n**Expected**: Referral created, share URL generated, link can be copied/shared.\n\n---\n\n### Step 3: Share Link ✅\n\n1. **Copy the referral link** from Step 2\n   - Format: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n\n2. **Verify link is shareable**:\n   - Can be copied to clipboard\n   - Native share works (if on mobile/PWA)\n\n**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   ",

        "contents": "import NextAuth from 'next-auth';\nimport { PrismaAdapter } from '@auth/prisma-adapter';\nimport EmailProvider from 'next-auth/providers/email';\nimport GoogleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/google';\nimport AppleProvider from 'next-auth/providers/apple';\nimport FacebookProvider from 'next-auth/providers/facebook';\nimport GitHubProvider from 'next-auth/providers/github';\nimport TwitterProvider from 'next-auth/providers/twitter';\nimport LinkedInProvider from 'next-auth/providers/linkedin';\nimport Credentials from 'next-auth/providers/credentials';\nimport { prisma } from './prisma';\n\nconst testEmail = process.env.TEST_USER_EMAIL ??         "contents": "# Full dev startup: .env.local, Docker Postgres, db push, seed/ensure-test-user, dev server\n# Run: npm run dev:full\n\n$ErrorActionPreference = \"Continue\"\n$root = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot \"..\")).Path\nSet-Location $root\n\ndocker info 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] Docker ei käivitu. Käivita Docker Desktop ja proovi: npm run dev:full\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n$localUrl = \"postgresql://voucher_user:voucher_pass@localhost:5432/voucher_db\"\n$authSecret = \"voucher-dev-secret-min-32-chars-long\"\n$envLocalPath = Join-Path $root \".env.local\"\n\n# 1) .env.local (local Postgres + AUTH_SECRET, et Next.js ja auth töötaks)\n@\"\n# Local Docker Postgres (dev:full)\nDATABASE_URL=\"$localUrl\"\nAUTH_SECRET=\"$authSecret\"\n\"@ | Set-Content -Path $envLocalPath -Encoding utf8 -Force\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] .env.local ok\" -ForegroundColor Green\n\n# 2) Docker Postgres\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting Postgres...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\ndocker compose up -d postgres 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Waiting for DB...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; \"$PSScriptRoot\\wait-for-db.ps1\" -MaxAttempts 30 -DelaySeconds 2\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] DB not ready. Check: docker compose logs postgres\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\n# 3) Prisma + seed (DATABASE_URL for Prisma CLI)\n$env:DATABASE_URL = $localUrl\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] prisma db push...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpx prisma db push\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:seed (may fail if data exists)...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:seed 2&gt;&amp;1 | Out-Null\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] db:ensure-test-user...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\n&amp; npm run db:ensure-test-user\nif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {\n  Write-Host \"[dev-full] ensure-test-user ebaõnnestus\" -ForegroundColor Red\n  exit 1\n}\n\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Test: test@example.com / test123\" -ForegroundColor Green\nWrite-Host \"[dev-full] Starting dev server...\" -ForegroundColor Cyan\nnpm run dev",

        "contents": "**Expected**: Link is valid and shareable.\n\n---\n\n### Step 4: Friend Redeems Voucher ✅\n\n1. **Open referral link in incognito/private window**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/r/[referralId]&#96;\n   - Should load without login\n   - Should show branded voucher\n   - Should show QR code\n\n2. **Redeem online**:\n   - Enter order amount (e.g., 100)\n   - Click \"Redeem Online\"\n   - Should create redemption via &#96;/api/redemptions&#96;\n   - Should show success message\n\n**Expected**: Redemption created, locked credit created for referrer.\n\n**Verify in database**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Check redemption was created\nSELECT id, \"voucherId\", \"referralId\", \"confirmedAt\" FROM \"Redemption\" ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n\n-- Check locked credit was created\nSELECT id, \"userId\", amount, status, \"sourceId\" FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE status = 'locked' ORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC LIMIT 1;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Step 5: Staff Confirms Redemption ✅\n\n1. **Login as merchant staff/admin**:\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;admin@coffee-house.com&#96;\n   - Check email for magic link\n\n2. **Go to redemptions page**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/merchant/coffee-house/redemptions&#96;\n   - Should see pending redemption (if method was &#96;in_store&#96;)\n   - For &#96;online&#96; method, redemption is auto-confirmed\n\n3. **Confirm redemption**:\n   - Click \"Confirm Redemption\" button\n   - Should call &#96;/api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96;\n   - Should unlock credit\n\n**Expected**: Redemption confirmed, credit unlocked.\n\n**Verify in database**:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Check redemption is confirmed\nSELECT id, \"confirmedAt\" FROM \"Redemption\" WHERE id = '[redemptionId]';\n\n-- Check credit is unlocked\nSELECT id, status FROM \"CreditLedger\" WHERE \"sourceId\" = '[redemptionId]';\n-- Status should be 'available'\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n### Step 6: Credit Appears Locked ✅\n\n1. **Login as referrer** (user from Step 2):\n   - Go to &#96;http://localhost:3000/login&#96;\n   - Use email: &#96;user@example.com&#96;\n\n2. **View wallet**:\n   - URL: &#96;http://localhost:3000/app/coffee-house/wallet&#96;",

        "contents": "   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   npm install\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n1. Set up environment variables:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   cp .env.example .env\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Edit &#96;.env&#96; and configure:\n\n   - &#96;DATABASE_URL&#96;: PostgreSQL connection string\n   - &#96;AUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - &#96;NEXTAUTH_SECRET&#96;: Random string (min 32 chars)\n   - OAuth providers (optional for local dev)\n   - SMTP settings (for email magic links)\n\n1. Start Docker services and set up database:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Quick setup (recommended - checks Docker, starts containers, waits for DB, pushes schema, seeds)\n   npm run db:setup\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   Or manually:\n\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n   # Check Docker Desktop is running\n   npm run db:check\n\n   # Start Docker containers\n   npm run docker:up\n\n   # Wait for database to be ready\n   npm run db:wait\n\n   # Push database schema\n   npm run db:push\n\n   # Seed database\n   npm run db:seed\n   &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n   **Troubleshooting**: If you encounter Docker issues, see [TROUBLESHOOTING.md](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md)\n\n1.         "contents": "5. **Redemption Creation** (&#96;app/api/redemptions/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Allow existing redemptions, but log warning\n\n### Where to Add Feature Flag Checks\n\nAdd feature flag checks to:\n\n1. **Weekly Drop Claim** (&#96;app/api/weekly-drop/claim/route.ts&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled&#96; flag\n\n2. **Voucher Builder** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/vouchers/new/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Show/hide weekly drop options based on flag\n\n3. **Analytics Dashboard** (&#96;app/merchant/[slug]/analytics/page.tsx&#96;)\n   - Check &#96;analyticsEnabled&#96; flag (V2)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n### Step 1: Create Merchant\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nINSERT INTO \"Merchant\" (id, name, slug, country, \"defaultCurrency\", \"isActive\", \"invitedAt\")\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  'New Merchant',\n  'new-merchant',\n  'US',\n  'USD',\n  true,\n  NOW()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Merchant Admin\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- First, create or find user\nINSERT INTO \"User\" (id, email, name, \"emailVerified\")\nVALUES (gen_random_uuid()::text, 'admin@new-merchant.com', 'Admin', NOW())\nON CONFLICT (email) DO NOTHING;\n\n-- Add as merchant admin\nINSERT INTO \"MerchantMember\" (id, \"merchantId\", \"userId\", role)\nVALUES (\n  gen_random_uuid()::text,\n  (SELECT id FROM \"Merchant\" WHERE slug = 'new-merchant'),\n  (SELECT id FROM \"User\" WHERE email = 'admin@new-merchant.com'),\n  'merchant_admin'\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Mark Onboarded\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" \nSET \"onboardedAt\" = NOW()\nWHERE \"slug\" = 'new-merchant';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Monitoring\n\n### Check Merchant Status\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  name,\n  slug,\n  \"isActive\",\n  \"invitedAt\",\n  \"onboardedAt\",\n  \"featureFlags\"\nFROM \"Merchant\"\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Audit Log\n\nAll kill switch actions are logged:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nSELECT \n  \"createdAt\",\n  action,\n  \"payloadJson\"\nFROM \"AuditLog\"\nWHERE action IN ('merchant_activated', 'merchant_deactivated')\nORDER BY \"createdAt\" DESC;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Best Practices\n\n1. **Always check &#96;isActive&#96; before allowing writes** - Prevents creating vouchers for inactive merchants\n2. **Log all kill switch actions** - Use &#96;deactivateMerchant()&#96; and &#96;activateMerchant()&#96; functions",

          "endPosition": {

        "contents": "- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/publish&#96; - Publish event\n- &#96;POST /api/events/[id]/generate-tickets&#96; - Generate tickets for event\n\n### Tickets\n\n- &#96;POST /api/tickets/[id]/purchase&#96; - Purchase ticket (Stripe checkout)\n\n### Referrals\n\n- &#96;POST /api/referrals/create&#96; - Create referral and get share URL\n\n### Redemptions\n\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions&#96; - Create redemption\n- &#96;POST /api/redemptions/[id]/confirm&#96; - Confirm redemption (staff)\n\n### Credits\n\n- &#96;GET /api/wallet/[merchantSlug]&#96; - Get credit balance\n- &#96;POST /api/credits/apply&#96; - Apply credit to order\n\n### Weekly Drop\n\n- &#96;POST /api/weekly-drop/claim&#96; - Claim weekly drop stock\n\n## Database Schema\n\nKey models:\n\n- &#96;Merchant&#96;: Tenant information\n- &#96;User&#96;: Platform users\n- &#96;MerchantMember&#96;: User-merchant relationships with roles\n- &#96;Voucher&#96;: Voucher definitions\n- &#96;Campaign&#96;: Campaign definitions (pricing, limits, credit percentages)\n- &#96;VoucherPurchase&#96;: Voucher purchase records\n- &#96;Event&#96;: Event definitions\n- &#96;Ticket&#96;: Ticket instances for events\n- &#96;TicketPurchase&#96;: Ticket purchase records\n- &#96;Referral&#96;: Referral instances\n- &#96;Redemption&#96;: Redemption records\n- &#96;CreditLedger&#96;: Credit transactions\n- &#96;CreditUsage&#96;: Credit application records\n- &#96;AuditLog&#96;: Audit trail\n\nSee &#96;prisma/schema.prisma&#96; for full schema.\n\n## Business Rules\n\n1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn\n2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific\n3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)\n4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals\n5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation\n6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically\n7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced\n\n## Testing\n\nRun tests:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm test\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deployment\n\n### Environment Variables",

            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Credit is NOT cash**: Cannot be transferred or withdrawn",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Per-merchant credits**: Credits are merchant-specific",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Credit expiration**: Default 60 days (configurable per merchant)",
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "4. **Self-referral prevention**: Users cannot redeem their own referrals",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "text": "5. **Credit locking**: Credits start as LOCKED, unlock after redemption confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "6. **Weekly drop stock**: Enforced atomically",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "7. **Usage limits**: Total and per-user limits enforced",
            "lineNumber": 254
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 255
          },
          {
            "text": "## Testing",
            "lineNumber": 256
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 257

        "contents": "  auditLogs        AuditLog[]\n}\n\nmodel Merchant {\n  id              String   @id @default(cuid())\n  name            String\n  slug            String   @unique\n  country         String\n  defaultCurrency String   @default(\"USD\")\n  brandLogoUrl    String?\n  brandColorsJson Json?\n  website         String?\n  supportEmail    String?\n  isActive        Boolean  @default(true)  // Kill switch for launch mode\n  featureFlags    Json?                    // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt       DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt     DateTime?                 // Track onboarding completion\n  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt       DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  members      MerchantMember[]\n  vouchers     Voucher[]\n  campaigns    Campaign[]\n  referrals    Referral[]\n  redemptions  Redemption[]\n  creditLedgers CreditLedger[]\n  creditUsages  CreditUsage[]\n  voucherPurchases VoucherPurchase[]\n  events          Event[]\n  tickets         Ticket[]\n  ticketPurchases TicketPurchase[]\n  auditLogs    AuditLog[]\n\n  @@index([isActive])\n}\n\nmodel MerchantMember {\n  id        String   @id @default(cuid())\n  merchantId String\n  userId    String\n  role      String   // merchant_admin | merchant_staff\n  createdAt DateTime @default(now())\n  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt\n\n  merchant Merchant @relation(fields: [merchantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)",

        "contents": "function LoginForm() {\nconst handleEmailSignIn = async \n\n    await signIn('email', { email, callbackUrl });\n    setIsLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4\"&gt;\n      &lt;Card className=\"w-full max-w-md\"&gt;\n        &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n          &lt;CardTitle&gt;{t('signIn')}&lt;/CardTitle&gt;\n          &lt;CardDescription&gt;{t('signInDescription')}&lt;/CardDescription&gt;\n        &lt;/CardHeader&gt;\n        &lt;CardContent className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n          &lt;form onSubmit={handleCredentialsSignIn} className=\"space-y-4\"&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"cred-email\"&gt;{t('email')}&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"cred-email\"\n                name=\"email\"\n                type=\"email\"\n                placeholder={t('emailPlaceholder')}\n                value={email}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; setEmail(e.target.value)}\n                required\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            &lt;div className=\"space-y-2\"&gt;\n              &lt;Label htmlFor=\"cred-password\"&gt;{t('password')}&lt;/Label&gt;\n              &lt;Input\n                id=\"cred-password\"\n                name=\"password\"\n                type=\"password\"\n                placeholder={t('passwordPlaceholder')}\n                value={password}\n                onChange={(e) =&gt; setPassword(e.target.value)}\n                required\n              /&gt;\n            &lt;/div&gt;\n            {error &amp;&amp; &lt;p className=\"text-sm text-destructive\"&gt;{error}&lt;/p&gt;}\n            &lt;Button type=\"submit\" className=\"w-full\" disabled={isLoading}&gt;\n              {isLoading ?         "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 69

        "contents": "# Launch Mode Configuration\n\nPer specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.\n\n## Current Implementation\n\n### Platform Admin\n- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;\n- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;\n- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring\n- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)\n\n### Merchant Member Management\n- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;\n- **Access**: Merchant admin only\n- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff\n- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)\n\n## Feature Flags (To Implement)\n\nThe specification requires:\n- Feature flags per merchant\n- Kill switch per merchant\n- Invite-only merchant signup\n\n### Recommended Implementation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Add to Merchant model\nmodel Merchant {\n  // ... existing fields\n  isActive      Boolean @default(true)  // Kill switch\n  featureFlags  Json?                   // Per-merchant feature flags\n  invitedAt    DateTime?                // Track manual invites\n  onboardedAt  DateTime?                // Track onboarding completion\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Feature Flag Examples\n- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;customDomainsEnabled: boolean&#96;\n- &#96;analyticsEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n- &#96;whiteLabelEnabled: boolean&#96; (V2 feature)\n\n## Manual Onboarding Flow\n\n1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API\n2. **Platform admin** adds merchant admin user via &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96; or database\n3. **Merchant admin** receives invite email (to implement)\n4. **Merchant admin** logs in and completes onboarding\n5. **Merchant** can start creating vouchers\n\n## Kill Switch\n\nTo disable a merchant:\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nUPDATE \"Merchant\" SET \"isActive\" = false WHERE \"slug\" = 'merchant-slug';\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThis should:\n- Hide merchant from public routes\n- Prevent new voucher creation\n- Allow existing redemptions to complete\n- Log action in AuditLog\n\n## No Public Signup\n\n- ✅ No public merchant signup form\n- ✅ No public user registration (except via OAuth/magic link)",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# Launch Mode Configuration",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "Per specification section 15, the platform is prepared for **invite-only merchants** with **manual onboarding**.",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "## Current Implementation",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "### Platform Admin",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Route**: &#96;/admin&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access**: Environment variable &#96;PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Purpose**: Manual merchant onboarding and monitoring",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status**: Minimal implementation (ready for expansion)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Merchant Member Management",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Route**: &#96;/merchant/[slug]/members&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access**: Merchant admin only",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Purpose**: Add/remove merchant staff",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Status**: Basic UI (add via database/API for now)",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "## Feature Flags (To Implement)",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "The specification requires:",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "- Feature flags per merchant",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "- Kill switch per merchant",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "- Invite-only merchant signup",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "### Recommended Implementation",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "// Add to Merchant model",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "model Merchant {",

          {

          },
          {
            "text": "### Feature Flag Examples",

          },
          {
            "text": "- &#96;weeklyDropsEnabled: boolean&#96;",

          },

          {
            "text": "1. **Platform admin** creates merchant via database/API",
